achievements.name: Desert Power
achievements.description:
Starting as an Arabian Tribe, have the Oasis privilege enacted, and more 
than 1000 development in the Arabian Region.

only the development of Desert and Coastal Desert provinces is counted for

valid to develop, requiring a average of 23 (22.7) development in each of

especially for Trier which is not the primary tag of its culture.

achievements.name: From Frankfurt to the Andes
achievements.description:
Starting as Frankfurt, form Jerusalem, and then form the Inca while owning 
Mallorca.
achievements.requirements:
- Was Frankfurt
- Was Jerusalem
- Is Inca
- Own Mallorca (333)
achievements.notes:
- Hardest part of this achievement is finding and fulfilling conditions 
for different tag formation.
- To form Jerusalem, you need to get into coring range of Jerusalem area 
(vassalize an Italian minor and conquer a province next to it), own and 
state Jerusalem area, move capital to Arabia, Egypt or Mashriq and switch 
from Republic to Monarchy. And this has to be done before the Age of 
Reformation ends, because Frankfurt can't form Jerusalem later.
- To form Inca you need to move your capital to the New World, own cores 
on required provinces, culture shift to Andean culture and change your 
religion to a pagan faith via rebels.
- Switching to play as a released vassal will invalidate the achievement.

achievements.name: Timurizz
achievements.description:
Starting as the Timurids, have 75 prestige, and 5 allies with 100 Trust 
and 150 opinion.
achievements.requirements:
- Prestige is at least *+75*
- Has at least 5 allies with 100 trust which have at least *+150* 
opinion of our country
achievements.notes:
The allies which have the trust have to be the same allies which have the 
opinion 

Trust can be gained by honoring calls to arms or by using the *Influence 
nation* interaction as a great power, or with The Cossacks or Leviathan by 
trading favors for trust. If neither The Cossacks nor Leviathan are active, 
trust with allies grows slowly over time.

achievements.name: Ultimate Military
achievements.description: As Songhai, have Prussia and Nepal as marches!
achievements.requirements:
- Is Songhai
- Have Prussia*and*Nepal as marches.
achievements.notes:
This achievement is only visible if the Origins DLC is active, but it is 
possible to get the achievement without that DLC. 

Songhai has a strong starting position, the main difficulty is making sure 
both Prussia and Nepal exist. Note that only Prussia can be formed by a 
subject nation, so you are better off giving a Nepali minor the required 
provinces by calling them to war as ally before subjugating them.

achievements.name: Triple the Rome
achievements.description: As Russia, be the Emperor of China and the HRE.
achievements.requirements:
- Is Russia
- Is Emperor of China
- Is the emperor of the Holy Roman Empire
achievements.notes:
To be Emperor of China, you must be in the Pagan or Eastern religion group, 
whilst to be the HRE Emperor, you generally must be Catholic unless Protestants 
won the league war, or sometimes other Christian denominations given 
specific circumstances (see League war), so a religion switch will be 
necessary to complete the achievement. Switching to a non-Christian 
religion as HRE Emperor will cause the emperorship to be lost unless the 
Erbkaisertum reform has been passed, while changing religion as Emperor of 
China allows you to retain the title. As such, it may be easiest to start 
as an atypical nation to form Russia such as Oirat, which starts off as Tengri 
and can use horde mechanics to relatively easily expand into the 
territories needed to form Russia. It is recommended to not seize the 
mandate until the needed provinces are conquered since seizing the mandate 
will change your government to Celestial Empire and disable horde 
mechanics. At this point, culture shift to Muscovite, Novgorodian or 
Ryazanian culture and form Russia once you hit admin tech 10. At some point 
you will need to conquer a Catholic province, perhaps from the Scandinavian 
or the Baltic regions, which will allow you to convert to Catholic via 
rebels. After seizing the Mandate of Heaven, convert to Catholicism, then 
ally or vassalize enough HRE electors to get yourself elected Holy Roman 
Emperor.

achievements.name: The Freest Man in the World
achievements.description:
Ensure that no colonized province in the world produces slaves while 
having the War Against the World Doctrine government reform enacted.
achievements.requirements:
- Has enacted the Pirate Republic government reform
- Has enacted the War Against the World Doctrine government reform
- No fully colonized province in the world produces slaves
achievements.notes:
Almost all slave provinces are on the African continent (except Azov). 
Palembang has a quick event which converts them into pirate republic, but 
they are Hindu and have mediocre ideas. An easier way is to start as Pasai 
and hoist the black flag: Pasai has better starting provinces, better 
ideas, and is Muslim, which makes alliance and AE easier. Alternatively, 
Gotland also becomes a pirate nation through event. Azov and the Ivory 
Coast are areas of contention with slaves which need to be rushed to asap. 
Kilwa has the best starting location and missions in Africa. Complete 
Prepare the Invasion mission to secure five provinces in Madagascar. Move 
Kilwa's capital to Zanzibar or Madagascar. Give the remaining provinces to 
Sofala and release the vassal, then Hoist the Black Flag

Can be done easily by releasing and playing as Cornwall after you conquer 
all slave provinces and abolish slavery, e.g. as England/Great Britain, 
because Cornwall's pirate event requires just 3 ships privateering. 

Maghrebi nation such as Tunis can sell non coastal provinces to meet the 
requirements, an alliance with the Ottomans and a proximity to Genoa help 
gaining Azov early in the game.

achievements.name: One nation to rule them all
achievements.description:
As Saruhan, have at least 9 loyal vassals with at least 100 development 
each.
achievements.requirements:
- Is Saruhan
- 9 countries fulfill the following conditions: 
- is a vassal of Saruhan
- has less than *50%* liberty desire
- has at least *100* development
achievements.notes:
Saruhan's core starts under the control of the Ottomans. Suggested 
strategy: expand rapidly as you normally would with the Ottomans until you 
have ~1200 development. Then, plan to release-and-play as Saruhan, taking 
most of Otto's lands. To do this, you will need to release Saruhan as 
vassal, wait 10 years, start to annex (to designate cores), feed it land, 
finalize annexation, and then release-and-play. You can cheese the 
release-and-play by feeding past the point of loyalty and then applying all 
available annexation cost reductions (Acquire Subjects mission, Influence 
idea, Amirs privilege, as well as any possible Policies). Make sure you 
wait until the last day of the month to do this, or else annexation 
progress will drop and you will be unable to proceed. As long as your 
annexation progress is above 100 on the month tick, it won't matter if 
liberty desire is over 50%. 

Once you have reannexed, you will be able to release-and-play. Ideally you 
will then own almost all Ottoman lands, making independence relatively easy 
to pursue. From there, you need to obtain 9 loyal vassals (NOT marches, NOT 
client states) with 100+ development. Rather than directly subjugating 
enemies to meet the vassal count, it is suggested that the player conquer 
and then release vassals; this avoids the forced vassalization malus. To 
help reduce liberty desire and thus total development needed, choose the 
relevant policies, and be sure to get the Splendor abilities in the Age of 
Revolutions (Anti-Revolutionary Zeal + Loyal Subjects). Upon release, you 
will no longer have the Ottoman government form, and should choose Iqta. 
Then on your goverment tab choose Lenient Taxation, which provides another 
Liberty Desire reduction. 

Note that during the feeding of Saruhan and following your transition to 
playing as them, the Ottomans will likely be severely weakened and thus 
open to attack. Keep this in mind, perhaps securing treaties in advance or 
locking in allies (though too many allies for Otto will make subsequent 
independence harder). Ideally you will be able to secure independence 
support from a rival.

As Air consider royal marrying Songhai and Mali and improving relations

are strong allies. After, look for choice targets and build over force 
limit by hiring a free company. Air starts with a level 2 fort on their 
capital so rushing smaller enemy capital forts is a viable strategy, no 
need to take unnecessary battles. 

You need 50 positive balance, not income. Consider disbanding armies, 
firing advisors and deleting forts when your income is over 60 ducats, with 
at least 50% gold income. Almost all expenses can be reduced to near 0 
except for state maintenance. To get enough gold income controlling and 
developing the three gold mines in West Africa should be enough. In 1444 
two are owned by Mali and one by Kong.

achievements.name: Copium Wars
achievements.description: Starting and playing as Ming, own the Britain region.
achievements.startingConditions:
- Playing as Ming
- AI-controlled custom nations are allowed, but they are not required
achievements.requirements:
- Is Ming
- Own all provinces in the Britain region

Britain region
achievements.notes:
This is one of only two achievements which allows a custom nation on the 
map which can't be earned by playing that custom nation.

achievements.name: Inner Turmoil
achievements.description:
Starting as The Isles, own 20 provinces by 1500, none of which are on 
Islands.
achievements.startingConditions:
- Playing as The Isles
- *Not* using a random New World
achievements.requirements:
- The year is before 1500
- owns at least 20 fully colonized provinces(cities) that are *not*on an 
island
achievements.notes:
it is allowed to have provinces on islands, but these don't count towards 
the 20. Islands in the context of this achievement means any province which 
does not have a land connection to mainland continents, meaning any 
province in Britain or Ireland will not count. Unfinished colonies also 
don't count. An easy way to achieve this is to wait until one of the berber 
nations is without allies and noCB them. You can core Moroccan and Sus 
provinces with extended range from exploration ideas and the colonial range 
advisor. From there, you can keep eating North Africa, or go to West 
Africa. The provinces do not need to be cored.

achievements.name: I don't like sand
achievements.description:
Have the most development while owning no province with terrain other than 
desert or coastal desert.
achievements.requirements:
- All provinces are either desert or coastal desert
- No other country has a higher development than this country

All desert and coastal desert provinces
achievements.notes:
Easiest as Ajuuraan or the Mamluks, because of their national ideas and the 
"Hydraulic Rights" estate privilege (which reduces the additional cost from 
developing deserts and coastal desert by half), that is unlocked through a 
mission in Origins DLC. Forming Arabia (possibly via Yemen to avoid the 
tech requirement) will unlock the similar "Oasis Development" privilege, 
which stacks with "Hydraulic Rights"

achievements.name: To the Bone
achievements.description: As Bone, use pillage capital at least 7 times.
achievements.startingConditions:
- Playing as Bone
- *Not* using a random New World
achievements.requirements:
- Is Bone
- Has used the pillage capital peace term at least 7 times

achievements.name: Surfing USA
achievements.description: Form the USA as Hawaii.
achievements.startingConditions:
- *Not* using a random New World
- Playing as Hawai'i, Maui, O'ahu*or*Kaua'i
achievements.requirements: Is USA
achievements.notes:
It is advised to not colonise the nearby islands in your region. To form USA 
you need to move your capital to the Colonial Eastern America region, and 
to be able to do that you will need to move your capital. This can be done 
if it's the only province in a state, i,e, Hawaii. Consider releasing 
vassals in your home islands to achieve this.

achievements.name: The Pheasant Strut
achievements.description:
As Gorkha form Nepal and defeat Prussia with at least 100,000 Prussian 
casualties in a war (both have to be primary targets of war).
achievements.requirements:
- Is Nepal
- Prussia must have lost at least 100,000 men in battles against Nepal 
in one war with both as primary participants
achievements.notes:
The game only counts the losses in battles which show Prussia's flag in the 
battle list at the bottom of the war overview screen. If there are other 
countries on Prussia's side, battles which show their flag are not counted. 
But their losses are counted in battles which show Prussia's flag. 

Brandenburg or Teutonic Order can form Prussia even when subjects, though 
they'll still need to be Protestant or Reformed. If Prussia doesn't form 
naturally, you can create them by vassalizing one of the above tags and 
giving them the required provinces, helping them grow large enough to field 
a lot of troops and declaring war on them once they form Prussia.

achievements.name: Eat your Greens
achievements.description: Control all Grasslands in Asia as Kale before the age of Absolutism.
achievements.requirements:
- It is *not* the Age of Absolutism or the Age of Revolutions
- Every province in Asia with Grasslands terrain is owned by the 
player's country *or* its non-tributary subjects

All grassland provinces in Asia
achievements.notes:
It is not required to keep playing as Kale to earn the achievement, but 
changing tag will hide it from the achievement tab. 

Start by subjugating and allying all Shan minors to complete the mission 
"Unite the Shan" to inherit them all and gain free cores (don't conquer any 
province from them as these would needlessly have to be cored; best to 
fully annex Ava and inherit all their tributaries). To limit AE and help 
with the endless conquests to come it is recommended you switch to horde 
government first, which is you should form Tibet and do the "Steppe 
Politics" mission. After choosing to invite one of the two Mongols switch 
culture back to Shan. Conquer enough of Indochina to form Siam for the 
ideas. 

Take Horde Ideas then Expansion then Diplomatic Ideas, don't delay 
colonizing Siberia. The colonies in the grassland provinces don't have to 
be finished, but you need to finish 3 colonies to reach the farthest 
province (2 if you conquer Onan Gol(1058) in Mongolia or Albazin (2102) in 
Manchuria instead of colonizing from the coast). 

The can be delayed by 30 years by ensuring that the highest valued trade 
node in the world contains no centers of trade at level 2 or higher, and no 
capital provinces.

achievements.name: The Reapers
achievements.description:
Starting as Aragon, be a Peasant Republic and have Madrid and Paris owned 
by any Peasant Republic.
achievements.requirements:
- Has enacted the Peasants Republic government reform
- The owner of the province Madrid (217) has enacted the Peasants 
Republic government reform
- The owner of the province Paris (183) has enacted the Peasants Republic 
government reform
achievements.notes:
The only feasible way to become a peasant republic as Aragon is with the 
third option in the event Sindicat Remença. As a republic, Aragon will *not* 
be eligible for the Iberian Wedding. However, swithing to a Peasants 
Republic after getting the Iberian Wedding will keep the Personal Union. A 
possible way to delay the event is to use « Return province » on any 
Catalonian province, since the event requires Aragon to own all of the 
Catalonia area.

achievements.name: Swahili Persuasion
achievements.description: As Kilwa, convert all of the Moluccas and Indonesia.
achievements.requirements:
- Is Kilwa
- all provinces in the regions Moluccas and Indonesia follow the state 
religion of Kilwa
achievements.notes:
Uncolonized provinces must also follow your state religion. Propagate 
religion is helpful however try to keep the Europeans out of the area as it 
won't convert Christian provinces. 

This achievement is only visible if the Origins DLC is active, but it can 
be achieved even without the DLC

achievements.name: No Country for Old Tercios
achievements.description:
As Spain, have Reformed Tercios, 33 Tercio Units, and control 3 Great 
Power capitals at the same time
achievements.requirements:
- Is Spain
- Has the modifier *“Reformed Tercio Regiments”* (from the mission Refine 
the Tercios)
- Has at least 33 tercio regiments
- Control the capitals of three great powers
achievements.notes:
To get the mission, Spain must be formed by a country which *never* was 
Aragon.

achievements.name: Get out of my swamp!
achievements.description:
As the Netherlands, own all of the Low Countries and have 50% or more Fort 
Defense.
achievements.requirements:
- The country is *or* was Netherlands
- Owns all provinces in the Low Countries region
- Has at least 50% fort defense
achievements.notes:
Defensive idea 5 gives *35%* fort defense, having a military engineer 
advisor gives another *20%*, and having *50* power projection gives the 
last *5%*

achievements.name: Doge Coins
achievements.description: Starting as Venice, become the Economic Hegemon.
achievements.requirements: - Is Economic Hegemon

achievements.name: Where Am I?
achievements.description:
As a New World native with Random New World active, explore the entire New 
World.
achievements.startingConditions:
- Government type is *Native*
- Capital is in the New World
- Is using a random New World
- No more than 1 custom nation exists in the world
- Used no more than 201 nation designer points if playing as a custom 
nation
achievements.requirements: Has discovered all provinces in the New World.
achievements.notes:
Eligible countries show “Tribe” as the government in the nation selection 
screen or are custom nations with one of the government reforms in the 
“Native” category 

Sometimes a random world is generated where all of the land is already 
discovered by most native nations, one only needs to unpause in order to 
get the achievement

- 
-

achievements.name: Why is the Rûm gone!?
achievements.description: As Asturias, establish an Order in Rum.
achievements.requirements:
- Is Asturias
- Own and have a holy order established in the Rum area
achievements.notes:
- Easiest to do as Ottomans. First, no-CB Castile and conquer the 
province of Vizcaya, then release Asturias as a vassal. Next, conquer 
enough Iberian provinces to connect Vizcaya to the Mediterranean as well as 
at least one province per sea tile connecting Iberia to all provinces in 
the Rum area, giving Asturias the line of provinces in each peace deal as 
well as any of your own provinces needed to complete the snake. Integrate 
and re-release Asturias, selecting to play as them, and then establish the 
holy order needed in order to complete the achievement. A similar strategy 
can be used if starting as Aragon, which owns most of the connecting 
provinces needed.

achievements.name: The Fezzan Corridors
achievements.description:
As Fezzan, control at least 90% of the trade power in Tunis, Katsina, Safi 
and Timbuktu.
achievements.requirements:
Have at least 90% trade power in Katsina, Safi, Timbuktu and Tunis trade 
nodes
achievements.notes:
Will likely require conquering (or at least occupying) much of Spain to 
prevent upstream trade power transfers to Tunis and Safi from Seville and 
Valencia.

achievements.name: Stiff Upper Lippe
achievements.description: As Lippe, own all of the British Isles.
achievements.requirements:
- Is Lippe
- Own all provinces in Britain

Britain region
achievements.notes:
Lippe doesn't exist in 1444, but it can be released from its core province 
Ravensberg (4775) which is owned by Berg. By first releasing Lippe as a 
regular vassal, giving them provinces to core and annexing them gives more 
land when releasing them again. 

Can be done as part of a HRE campaign. Ensure Lippe exists before you pass 
"Revoke the Privilegia". Feed all of Britain's cores to your Lippe vassal 
and then either annex Lippe or pass the final reform "Renovatio Imperii", 
then release and play as Lippe, earning you the achievement.

achievements.name: Stern des Südens
achievements.description: Form Bavaria starting as München and have your Subject Bremen own Werder.
achievements.startingConditions:
- Playing as Munich
- *Not* using a random New World
achievements.requirements:
- Is Bavaria
- Bremen is a subject of Bavaria
- Bremen owns Werder (2778)
achievements.notes:
Werder (2778) is in the Horn of Africa region and owned by Marehan at the 
start of the game. As Munich, take your time consolidating into Bavaria. If 
you can, befriend the emperor and/or electors to make your life within the 
HRE easier. Once you have a border with Bremen, or coastal provinces in 
coring range of Bremen, look for war opportunities which Bremen will be 
called ito as an ally. As they are a free city, it will be much harder if 
you declare directly on them (as the Emperor will defend free cities). 
Annex Bremen in a separate peace and release them as your vassal (you can't 
vassalize a free city in a peace deal). Afterwards, expand in power so that 
you can combat your most powerful neighbours - Ottomans, Spain, France, 
etc. Make sure to give Bremen land, either in the direction of the Ottomans 
or in the direction of Spain. You will have to fight your way through at 
least one, feeding Bremen provinces to "snake" their land down to Werder 
(this is because vassals need adjacent land or sea tiles to be given 
provinces and do not care about coring distance/colonial range). The least 
time-consuming method would be to give them a province per sea tile 
starting from the Mediterranean, down through the Mamluks to the Red Sea 
coast, and finally down to Werder.

achievements.name: Pick Your Poison
achievements.description: As Kaffa, develop in Cafa while a subject of yours owns it.
achievements.requirements:
- Developed in Caffa (285).
- Any subject nation owns Caffa.
achievements.notes: Caffa is in the Pontic Steppe region, initially owned by Genoa.

achievements.name: Pandya Empire
achievements.description: Starting as Madurai, conquer the Pandya Territories.
achievements.requirements:
Own all provinces in the region of Coromandel and the areas of Malabar, 
Mysore, and Rayalaseema

achievements.name: Mass Production
achievements.description: Starting as Odoyev, own one of every manufactory.
achievements.requirements: Own at least one manufactory of each type
achievements.notes:
- The new manufactories (Ramparts, Soldier's Households, Impressment 
Offices, State House) are also necessary
- With the Rule Britannia DLC a furnace is also necessary.
- Building the manufactories isn't very hard. The hard part is surviving 
long enough to get to the required technology (admin tech 16 without Rule 
Britannia and till the Enlightenment with the DLC) as well as getting 
provinces with the correct trade goods.

achievements.name: Everything's Coming Up Mulhouse
achievements.description:
Starting as Mulhouse, become Emperor of the HRE and completely 
decentralize the Empire.
achievements.startingConditions:
- Playing as Mulhouse
- *Not* using a random New World
achievements.requirements:
- Is the emperor of the Holy Roman Empire
- Has enacted the reform Reichskrieg
achievements.notes:
Mulhouse starts as a republic, and needs to become a monarchy to be able to 
become the Holy Roman Emperor.

achievements.name: Dovmont's Own
achievements.description: Starting as Pskov, have 100 standing Streltsy units.
achievements.requirements: Has at least 100 Streltsy units

achievements.name: That's No Mon
achievements.description: As Pegu, own at least 50 provinces that are not of the Mon culture.
achievements.startingConditions:
- Playing as Pegu
- *Not* using a random New World
achievements.requirements:
- Is Pegu
- At least 50 owned provinces do not have Mon culture
achievements.notes:
This achievement is only visible if the Leviathan DLC is active, but it can 
be achieved even without the DLC. This can be done at the same time as the Sailor 
Mon achievement, and will often occur without any additional effort. With 
Leviathan, the Pegu mission tree grants a subjugation cb on Ayutthaya, 
which can lead to quite a large acquisition of provinces. The player can 
also flip cultures to Burmese to ensure colonies are not of Mon culture and 
can culture convert their original provinces to a new culture.

achievements.name: Sun Invasion
achievements.description:
As the Madyas, own and have cores on Tepeacac, Mexico, Tullucan and 
Huastec.
achievements.requirements:
- Is Madyas
- Own and core the provinces of Tepeacac (2628), Mexico (852), Tullucan 
(2626) and Tlapacoyan(853, formerly called Huastec).
achievements.notes:
You need to directly own and core the target provinces, and not through 
your colonial nation. There are several ways to achieve this: 

Move your capital city to North America before a colonial nation forms. 

Get a colonial nation in one of the colonial regions adjacent to Mexico and 
grant them a chain of colonized or conquered provinces in Mexico up to the 
achievement provinces with the help of the grant province subject 
interaction(or by transferring occupations in a war if they are on the same 
continent as the capital of the CN). The achievement provinces can be cored 
as soon as the colonial nation has cored a province next to them. 

Vassalize a native, take land from some other native including the needed 
ones and a chain of provinces leading to the coast. Core one coastal 
province to be able to start coring the 4 achievement provinces. To avoid 
forming a colonial nation, the cored coastal province then has to be given 
to the vassal. 

Use the Unrestricted Conquest age ability from the Age of Revolutions. 

Simply annexing a vassal in the region won't fire the achievement.

achievements.name: Shemot is Not
achievements.description:
As a Jewish nation, convert all of Egypt to Jewish while having the Jewish 
Community Aspect active.
achievements.requirements:
- Religion is Jewish
- The church aspect “*Jewish Community*” is active
- All provinces in the Egypt region are Jewish
achievements.notes:
Easiest to do as Mamluks. Conquer Semien (and Dembiya) in Ethiopia and 
immediately send a missionary with 0 maintenance to switch the rebels to 
Jewish Zealots (before the previous rebel type in the province has reached 
30% progress). Let the rebels spawn and let them convert the country. Once 
Jewish has become the dominant religion, the rebel demands will also 
include to change the state religion. Then the demands can be accepted, but 
it might be beneficial to let them convert more provinces. After becoming 
Jewish, finish converting Egypt and choose Jewish Community as your first 
aspect.

achievements.name: Mansa Musa
achievements.description:
As Mali, give 10k ducats away to another great power without having a 
single loan or being bankrupt.
achievements.requirements:
- Is Mali
- Has given at least 10k ducats to a great power with a single use of 
the diplomatic action Send gift
- Has no loans
- Is not bankrupt
achievements.notes:
This achievement is only visible if the Origins DLC is active, but it is 
possible to get the achievement without that DLC.

achievements.name: King of Kings
achievements.description: Complete the Persian mission tree.
achievements.requirements:
- Complete the Sunni or Shia or Zoroastrian version of the Persian 
missions

achievements.name: Atwix Legacy
achievements.description: Have 10 personal unions at the same time.
achievements.requirements: Have 10 or more personal unions
achievements.notes:
A good way is to choose a country with many PUs in its mission tree such as 
Hungary, Bohemia or Austria. Follow Atwix guide and make use of the new 
favor feature to spread your dynasty. Ensure that your PU subjects are 
fairly large to avoid inheriting their throne.

achievements.name: Imposter Syndrome
achievements.description:
As Sus, have three countries hostile to you (less than 0 opinion) after 
they discovered your spy.
achievements.requirements:
- Is Sus
- Three countries fulfill the following conditions: 
- have a negative opinion of this country
- have the opinion modifier “*Did Covert Actions*” towards this 
country
achievements.notes:
Being a subject of Morocco does not prevent you from spying on other 
countries and independence is therefore not required. You simply need to 
use your two diplomats to build spy network in any country. There is about 
an 85% chance three nations will discover your spies within the first ten 
years. If your relations with them are still positive, insult them. Before 
unpausing the game, search for the countries with starting rulers with 
Secretive personality which gives *+20%* foreign spy detection.

achievements.name: Empire of Mann
achievements.description: As Mann, conquer all Islands in the world.
achievements.requirements:
- Is Mann
- Own *or* have non-tributary subjects own all provinces which are on an 
island.
achievements.notes:
Mann can't be selected as a country in 1444, you must release it as a 
vassal and choose the option to play as a released vassal. 

As England release Mann at the very start of the game. After 10 years you 
can annex them again. As the annexation progresses grant them your 
provinces bit by bit before the process hits 100%. You can even move your 
capital to continental Europe and give London to Mann. Be careful about 
France as they will likely attack you once you are weakened. After 
annexation is finished spend all your monarch points to boost provinces 
that Mann considers as a core. Now release Mann again and chose to play as 
a released vassal. 

Alternatively, sabotage England as much as possible, such as releasing all 
releasable nations, leaving Mann for last. Release and play as them, then 
ally all other released nations, plus a major like Castile. Take London, 
Sussex, and Kent in your first war and you should be off to a great start.

achievements.name: Around the World in 80 Years
achievements.description:
Starting as a Custom Nation of up to 400 points in the British Region, own 
New York, San Francisco, Suez, Bombay, Calcutta, Hong Kong and Yokohama by 
1524.11.11.
achievements.startingConditions:
- Playing as a custom nation
- Only 1 custom nation exists in the world
- Used no more than 401 nation designer points
- *Not* using a random New World
- Own no provinces outside the Britain region
achievements.requirements:
- The date is before 12 November 1524
- Own Manahahttan (965), Ohlone (4637), Suez (2315), Thana (529), Bengal 
Delta (561), Canton (667), and Musashi (1028)
achievements.notes:
Requires Ohlone (4637) instead of Miwok/San Francisco (2021). Provinces 
cannot be owned by subject, so it is important not to establish colonial 
nations in North America. Considerably easier with the charter company 
mechanism from Dharma.

-

achievements.name: With a little help..
achievements.description:
As Ragusa, lead a Trade League of at least 5 nations and guarantee the 
Ottomans’ independence.
achievements.requirements:
- Lead a Trade League of at least 5 nations
- Guarantee the independence of Ottomans
achievements.notes:
You can only guarantee a country if you are larger than it. Ironically, 
taking land from the Ottomans for a vassal is probably the best way to do 
this.

achievements.name: Turkish Delight
achievements.description: Start as Candar and own 20 Sugar provinces between you and your subjects.
achievements.requirements:
Have 20 provinces of sugar owned by this country and its non-tributary 
subjects
achievements.notes:
Fleeing to the new world is recommended, if not required for this 
achievement.

achievements.name: Tiger of Mysore
achievements.description: Starting as Mysore, Conquer the Deccan and Coromandel Regions.
achievements.requirements:
- All provinces in Deccan and Coromandel regions are owned by the 
country or a non-tributary subject
achievements.notes:
You need to ally Bahmanis to make it possible to defeat Vijayanagar If you 
can't, then you might have to restart a few times or no-cb a country in 
southeast Asia

achievements.name: The 52 Garhs
achievements.description: As Garhwal own and maintain 52 forts without going into debt.
achievements.requirements:
- Has no loans
- Own at least 52 forts (level 2)

achievements.name: Sworn Fealty
achievements.description:
Starting as an Arabian Tribal Federation, unite Arabia and have Maximum 
tribal Allegiance.
achievements.startingConditions:
- Culture group is *Levantine*
- Culture is not *Turkish*
- Has the Tribal Federation government reform
achievements.requirements:
- Is Arabia
- Have *100*Tribal Allegiance
achievements.notes:
Possible starts are Anizah, Dawasir, Fadl, Najd, Najran, Shammar and Yas. 

The only way to get Tribal Allegiance within the constraints of this 
achievement is by keeping the Tribal Federation government reform. This 
reform *cannot* be selected again after losing it, so it is mandatory to 
*never* switch government types (e.g. with one of the tier 6 government 
reforms or via the first option of the Arabian mission event A New Caliphate) 
or do something else which gives a different tier 1 reform. 

To get Tribal Allegiance quickly as a large nation, humiliate rivals and 
allow enemies to rebuild armies so you can wipe them for prestige (since 
battle prestige gives Tribal Allegiance). The Offensive idea group is 
useful as it doubles prestige gain from battle victories. The Tier 6 reform Tribal 
Unity, as well as both monuments in Cairo at magnificent tier, give *+1* 
yearly Tribal allegiance each, which will help to offset the loss of Tribal 
Allegiance due to development (capped at *-0.25* monthly at 1000 
development).

achievements.name: Protect the Secret
achievements.description:
As Yemen, prevent any European Nation from owning a Coffee-producing 
province in the Old World until 1700.
achievements.requirements:
- Culture is *Yemeni*
- Is year 1700 or later
- Is Yemen
- No coffee-producing provinces in the continents of Asia, Africa, or 
Oceania are held by a country with its capital in Europe.
achievements.notes:
Conditions may be fulfilled any time after 1699, and do not need to be 
fulfilled before that time. Yemen is reformable via culture shift, so this 
is very attainable playing as any country. Can be combined with the Arabian 
Coffee achievement. Do not form Arabia

achievements.name: Foremost Servitor of Jagannath
achievements.description: Start as Orissa and own or have a subject own all tropical wood provinces.
achievements.requirements:
All provinces with tropical wood are owned by the player's country or its 
non-tributary subjects. 
Provinces producing tropical wood at game start (orange) and uncolonized 
provinces capable of producing tropical wood (yellow)

achievements.name: Core-fu
achievements.description: Force a nation to revoke 5 cores in one peace deal as Corfu.
achievements.requirements:
- Is Corfu
- Forced a country to revoke 5 cores in one peace deal
achievements.notes:
Although this achievement can theoretically be started as any nation due to 
Corfu being a releasable nation, the cores need to be revoked while you are 
Corfu. Forcing a nation to revoke cores as another nation, then releasing 
Corfu will not count.

achievements.name: Bunte Kuh
achievements.description: As Hamburg, trade in both Gems and Livestock.
achievements.requirements:
- Has country modifier *Trading in Livestock*
- Has country modifier *Trading in Gems*
achievements.notes:
The "trading in" bonus is gained by controlling 20% of the trade value of a 
given commodity, calculated as the sum of the value of a good produced in a 
node times the percentage of trade you control in that node, added up for 
every node in the world. It is not necessary to expand further than 
Northern Europe in order to achieve the necessary economy. There are two 
gems provinces (Königsberg and Danzig) just upstream of Hamburg that can be 
highly developed in order to add up to the 20% necessary. The goods 
produced in these provinces can be maximized by adding the rest of Baltic 
trade node to a trade company (which gives a goods produced bonus to all 
other provinces in the node) and stating the two gems provinces. There are 
many livestock provinces in Denmark and around the Baltic that can be used 
to gain the trading in livestock bonus. Keep in mind that manufactories 
will contribute to the bonus, but workshops will not. You may wish to form 
Lübeck to gain better trade ideas. Plutocratic, Trade, and Infrastructure 
ideas are all helpful.

achievements.name: Avar Khaganate
achievements.description: Achieve Empire rank and conquer Hungary as Avaria.
achievements.requirements:
- Is empire
- Avaria owns all provinces in the areas Alföld, Transdanubia, Slovakia, 
Northern Transylvania, and Southern Transylvania.

achievements.name: The League of Mayapan
achievements.description: Starting as Huastec, form Maya.
achievements.requirements: Is Maya
achievements.notes:
Playing without El Dorado makes this achievement considerably faster and 
easier since you will not need to reform your religion, which can include 
decades of waiting for Europeans to show up.

achievements.name: Kuban Cigars
achievements.description:
As Kuba, own or have a subject own Havana and be the world’s leading 
producer of Tobacco.
achievements.requirements:
- Own or have a non-tributary subject own the province Havana (484)
- The leading producer of Tobacco is *either* this country or a subject 
of this country
achievements.notes:
- Not possible with Random New World.
- Making the leading tobacco producer a tributary would count.

achievements.name: Ganges Khan
achievements.description: Start as Tribal nation in India and become a Steppe Horde.
achievements.startingConditions:
- Government type is Tribal
- Capital is in India superregion
achievements.requirements: - Has the Steppe Nomads government reform
achievements.notes:
- This achievement is only visible if the Dharma *or* Emperor DLC is

achievements.name: Brentry!
achievements.description:
Starting as England, form the Angevin Kingdom and enact all the 'Acts of 
Crown' parliamentary issues.
achievements.requirements:
- Is Angevin Kingdom
- Has enacted all of the following parliament issues: 
- Crown of Ireland Act
- Act of the Spanish Crown
- Act of the Italian Crown
- Crown of the Empire
achievements.notes:
Do *not* dismantle the HRE, because that prevents the issue *“Crown of the 
Empire”*. It's recommended to stay Catholic as becoming HRE emperor as 
Anglican requires either religious peace or Protestant victory with around 
a quarter of HRE provinces under Anglican control.

achievements.name: Assembly Instructions Needed
achievements.description:
Form Scandinavia and revoke the privilegia of the Holy Roman Empire while 
being the Emperor.
achievements.requirements:
One of the following: 

- Is Scandinavia and the emperor of the HRE and has passed the imperial 
reform *“Revoke The Privilegia”*
- Is the Holy Roman Empire and was Scandinavia before
achievements.notes:
Easy to do as Denmark. Restart until Burgundy is friendly, hire diplomatic 
reputation advisor, take religious diplomats estate privilege, and insult 
their rival. This should guarantee alliance and marriage for potential BI. 
Then ally and max relations with 3-4 electors, and you should become the 
emperor. Then the standard HRE approach of killing the Reformation. Join 
the HRE for a one-time IA boost. Ideas: Diplomatic, Religious, Influence. 
Diplomatic reputation for passing reforms and inheriting thrones and 
Religious to convert centers of reformation. Emperor Denmark also has an 
easy time killing Swedish pretender rebels.

achievements.name: Truly Good Maaaaa-tch
achievements.description:
Starting as either Aq Qoyunlu or Qara Qoyunlu, have a royal marriage and 
an alliance with Ramazan.
achievements.startingConditions: Is Aq Qoyunlu or Qara Qoyunlu
achievements.requirements:
- Is Aq Qoyunlu or Qara Qoyunlu
- Has an alliance with Ramazan
- Has a royal marriage with Ramazan
achievements.notes:
Can be achieved in a little over a month. Take out a loan, send 50 ducats 
to Ramazan, send a scornful insult to one of their rivals, then send an 
alliance offer after a month. Ramazan should send you a marriage offer 
within a few days.

achievements.name: Where the heart is
achievements.description: As Dahomey, force all non-Fetishist nations out of Niger and Sahel by 1500.
achievements.requirements:
- The year is before 1500
- All colonised provinces in the Niger and Sahel regions are owned by a Fetishist 
nation.
achievements.notes:
- The owner must be Fetishist, not the province. Possible to do by 
feeding lots of land to a Sunni vassal and then enforcing religion.

achievements.name: Spanish Fly
achievements.description: Starting as Offaly, secure a Personal Union over an Iberian nation.
achievements.requirements:
- Lead a personal union over a country whose capital fulfills both of 
the following conditions: 
- is in the Iberia region
- has a province culture in the Iberian culture group
achievements.notes:
Forming Ireland or another country *will not* prevent the achievement but 
instead only hiding its conditions. Take a single Spanish province with a 
core of another tag and release that tag as a vassal. Place dynasty member 
on the throne and annex the vassal. Return their core via the province 
screen to release them as an independent nation with your dynasty ruling. 
Claim their throne, immediately declare with restoration of union CB and 
enforce union for the achievement. 

It is also possible to obtain a "Restoration of Union" casus belli on Spain/
Castile by forming France and completing the mission French Claim to Naples 
(requires having the Emperor DLC activated and the Domination not active).

achievements.name: Great Perm
achievements.description:
As Perm, own or have a subject own the Russian, Siberian, Scandinavian, 
Canadian, Hudson Bay and Cascadian Regions.
achievements.requirements:
- *Not* playing as a released vassal
- Is Perm
- All provinces in the Canada, Cascadia, Hudson Bay, East Siberia, West 
Siberia, Scandinavia, Russia and Ural regions are owned by Perm*or* its 
non-tributary subjects.

achievements.name: Basque in Glory
achievements.description:
Starting as Navarra, ensure that most of Iberia is Basque culture before 
the Age of Absolutism.
achievements.requirements:
- It is *not* the Age of Absolutism or the Age of Revolutions
- At least 32 provinces in Iberia have Basque culture

achievements.name: Forgive me, for I have Sindh
achievements.description: Become Christian as Sindh.
achievements.requirements:
- Is Sindh
- Religion is in Christian group
achievements.notes:
The island Suqutra is the nearest Christian province and can be easily 
conquered from its owner Mahra, who will normally ally your neighbor 
Baluchistan. Sell your province Umarkot to a neighboring country (since 
Baluchistan does not want it) and declare war on them with your reconquest 
casus belli. Then, head to Mahra to eliminate their armies and siege their 
provinces until they will accept giving you Suqutra in a separate peace 
deal (you do not need to land any troops on the island for it to be 
selectable). Next, give Baluchistan all of your mainland provinces in a 
peace deal and declare bankruptcy. Since you are an OPM on a Coptic 
province, this will convert you to Coptic and grant the achievement.

achievements.name: Spaghetti Western
achievements.description: Starting as Bologna, become Mexico or Texas.
achievements.startingConditions:
- Playing as Bologna
- *Not* using a random New World
achievements.requirements: Is Mexico*or*Texas*or*Sonora
achievements.notes:
Easiest to do by forming a colonial nation in the Mexico colonial region 
(to form Mexico) or the Rio Grande region (to form Texas) and then release 
and play as them which requires Conquest of Paradise. But it is also 
possible to form Mexico or Texas by moving your capital to the previously 
mentioned (colonial) region before a colonial nation forms. Then no DLC is 
necessary.

achievements.name: Philippine Tiger
achievements.description: As Cebu, recreate the Chola Empire.
achievements.requirements:
- Is Cebu
- Own the following provinces:

achievements.name: Never say Nevers
achievements.description: As Nevers, own the entire France region as core provinces.
achievements.requirements:
- Is Nevers
- Own and have cores on every province in the France region.

achievements.name: Meissner Porcelain
achievements.description: As Saxony, own or have a subject own all Chinaware provinces in the world.
achievements.requirements:
- *Not* playing as a released vassal
- Is Saxony
- All provinces with chinaware are owned by Saxony or its non-tributary 
subjects.
achievements.notes: Chinaware appears in China, Japan, Korea and the East Indies.

achievements.name: Kushite Restoration
achievements.description:
As a Nubian culture nation, own or have a non-Tributary subject own the 
entire Egyptian region.
achievements.requirements:
All provinces in the Egypt region are owned by the player's country *or* 
its non-tributary subjects.
achievements.notes: Possible starts are Dongola, Alodia, and Makuria.

achievements.name: It's All Greek To Me
achievements.description: Form Greece and own and have cores on Zeta, Thatta, Lamba, and Roh.
achievements.requirements:
- Is Greece
- Own the core provinces of Zeta (138), Thatta (504), Roh (578), and 
Lamba (4104)
achievements.notes:
- Forming Greece requires Greek primary culture. Zeta begins held by 
Serbia, Thatta held by Sindh, Roh held by Afghanistan, and Lamba 
uncolonized in Central Africa.
- Alternatively, you can conquer Byzantium and wait for Greek cores to 
form after the Greek Separatism event fires (requires Admin Tech 20). 
Release Greece as a vassal and feed him the required provinces. Once they 
are cored, diplomatically annex Greece and release them again, but chose to 
play as Greece this time. Note that since Thatta is in a Trade Company 
region you must own the province yourself to state and fully core it before 
giving it to Greece, otherwise they will lose their territorial core upon 
annexing.

achievements.name: Holy Horder
achievements.description:
Starting as the Teutonic Order, form the Mongol Empire while have the Holy 
Horde government reform enacted.
achievements.requirements:
- *Not* playing as a released vassal
- Is the Mongol Empire
- Has enacted the Holy Horde government reform
achievements.notes:
To form the Mongol Empire as the Teutonic Order you need to choose the 
crusader path of missions after completing Defeat Poland, this will unlock 
the mission Crusaders of the Steppes which allows forming the Mongol Empire 
due to the unique government reform.

achievements.name: Cotton Kandy
achievements.description: As Kandy be production leader in Cotton.
achievements.requirements:
- Is Kandy
- Be production leader of cotton
achievements.notes:
The Indian sub-continent already has the highest concentration of 
cotton-producing provinces in the game, so this achievement is best 
partnered with The Buddhists Strike Back.

achievements.name: Breaking the Yoke
achievements.description: As Ryazan, own Saratov, Crimea and Kazan while being independent.
achievements.requirements:
- Is *not* a subject nation
- Own the provinces of Crimea (284), Kazan (1082) and Saratov (303)

achievements.name: Victorian Three
achievements.description:
As Busoga, Buganda or Karagwe, reach administrative, diplomatic and 
military technology level 32.
achievements.requirements:
- Administration technology is *32*
- Diplomatic technology is *32*
- Military technology is *32*
achievements.notes:
Most easily accomplished by manually spawning Renaissance, Colonialism and 
Printing Press, and not expanding too much. To get the other institutions, 
build manufactories and universities. Researching level 32 loses the 
ahead-of-time penalty in 1820.

achievements.name: Super Trooper
achievements.description:
Starting as Sweden, enact the Allotment System government reform, have 80 
regiments of Carolean raised at the same time with at least +40% infantry 
combat ability.
achievements.requirements:
- / Has enacted the Allotment System government reform
- Has at least 80 carolean regiments
- Infantry combat ability is at least *40%*
achievements.notes:
Take quality and innovative ideas for *45%* infantry combat ability with 
swedish ideas. Since only development from swedish and finnish cultured 
provinces counts towards increasing how many carolean regiments are 
available you need to culture convert other provinces to reach 800 
development.

achievements.name: Napoleon’s Ambition
achievements.description: As Revolutionary France, spread the Revolution to 10 countries.
achievements.requirements:
- Is France
- has used the *“Spread the Revolution”* peace term 10 times
achievements.notes:
"Spread the Revolution" peace term can only be used by the revolution target 
against nations that have at least one province the Center of Revolution 
hasn't spread to. They can also only be used against the country directly 
attacked with the CB (not any allies). Best done quickly as revolutionary 
ideas can spread across the entire world, preventing the achievement. Small 
nations in the Americas, Africa and Asia can be targeted to get to 10 if 
necessary.

achievements.name: Home and Away
achievements.description: As Wales, hold Cardiff, Dublin, Edinburgh, Rome, Paris and London.
achievements.requirements:
- Is Wales
- Own Glamorgan (241), Pale (373), Lothian (248), Roma (118), Paris 
(183) and London (236)
achievements.notes:
- It is not needed to core the required provinces.
- The welsh names of the provinces in eu4 are Morgannwg(241), 
Dulyn(373), Lleuddiniawn(248), Rhufain(118), Paris(183) and Llundain(236)

achievements.name: Don’t be Cilli
achievements.description: Starting as Cilli, form another nation.
achievements.startingConditions:
- Playing as Cilli
- *Not* using a random New World
achievements.requirements:
- is *not*Cilli
- *Not* playing as a released vassal
achievements.notes:
Can be done by annexing Croatia, then culture shifting and re-forming it. 
Use the fact that you are eligible to form a royal marriage with both 
Austria and Hungary in the early game and later grab alliances with Poland 
and/or Bohemia to defeat Hungary for the important provinces.

achievements.name: Disciples of Enlightenment
achievements.description: Starting as Dai Viet, have 10 nations follow the Mahayana Faith by 1500.
achievements.requirements:
- The year is before 1500
- At least 10 nations follow the Mahayana faith
achievements.notes:
- Note that the player's country itself does count.
- Pahang and Pangasinan already start as Mahayana and Dai Viet itself 
also counts, effectively bringing down the requirement to 7, and the 
Philippine islands are an excellent place to start forcing conversions.

achievements.name: The Third Way
achievements.description:
Start as an Ibadi nation and eliminate all rival schools of Islam (do not 
convert to another religion).
achievements.requirements:
- *Not* playing as a released vassal
- Is Ibadi
- No province is Sunni or Shia.
achievements.notes:
Possible starts are Mzab, Oman, and Pate. Uncolonized provinces with Muslim 
religion (south of Morocco, Tunis and Ethiopia) must also be colonized and 
converted to Ibadi. With Golden Century, European countries like Spain and 
Portugal can convert provinces in the colonial regions to Islam by 
expelling minorities. Those provinces must be converted to Ibadi as well.

achievements.name: The Animal Kingdom
achievements.description: As Manipur, unite the Bengal region and convert it to Animism.
achievements.requirements:
- All provinces in the Bengal region are owned by the player's country 
*or* its non-tributary subjects.
- All provinces in the Bengal region are Animist
achievements.notes:
As soon as you can, take on your western neighbours, Kachar and/or Tripura. 
You will not have much luck east from game start, as Ava will guard it's 
tributaries. Best option is to not conquer both provinces, but to take one 
as a vassal - and a second OPM vassal in india as soon as possible as well. 
You can force them to be animist and feed them Indian culture provinces 
that you conquer. Allies are hard to come by, and vassals will be obliged 
to help you, pay you, give you extra force limit, etc.. Look for an 
opportunity to eat nations up north such as Assam, Sadiya, Mong Kawng, and 
Koch before Bengal annexes them or Ming makes them a tributary. Delay 
becoming a tributary of Ming as long as possible (or never if you can), but 
do not be afraid to use it as an inroad for expansion east as Ming will 
have a lot of tributary states in that direction. Once you are set up, it's 
the same as any other OPM-to-#1-Great-Power game. Get religious ideas to 
make conversions faster, especially against Islamic provinces.

achievements.name: Raja of the Rajput Reich
achievements.description: Conquer all of Germany as Nagaur.
achievements.requirements:
- *Not* playing as a released vassal
- All provinces in North Germany and South Germany regions are owned by 
the player's country *or* its non-tributary subjects.
achievements.notes:
One possible start is to quickly ally Jaunpur and then call them in against 
Delhi, who are weak at the start due to large disloyal vassal Sirhind. Take 
the provinces of Delhi, Sirhind, Lahore, and connecting provinces. You can 
then reform Delhi once they're wiped out, which will give you several 
hundred development of cores for free as well as a fairly strong idea set 
and mission tree. You can later culture-shift and form Mughals for an even 
stronger idea set and tree. Alternatively you can form Rajputana and maybe 
even Hindustan. With a strong power base, you are ready to expand northwest 
to Germany.

achievements.name: Norwegian Wood
achievements.description: Own or have a subject own all naval supplies provinces as Norway.
achievements.requirements: Own or have a non-tributary subject own all provinces with naval supplies.
achievements.notes:
Before patch 1.36.2, it was required that the provinces were owned by Norway 
or Norway's subjects, but since patch 1.36.2, they have to be owned by the 
player's country and its subjects, so the player can form any country and 
still get the achievement without having to get Norway back on the map.

achievements.name: An Unlikely Candidate
achievements.description: Starting as Mzab, Touggourt or Djerid, reform Al-Andalus.
achievements.requirements: Is Andalusia
achievements.notes:
Forming Algiers, Morocco, Tunis or another country *will not* prevent the 
achievement but instead only hide its conditions.

achievements.name: Academical
achievements.description: As Athens, own 50 universities.
achievements.requirements:
- *Not* playing as a released vassal
- Is Athens
- 50 owned provinces have Universities.

achievements.name: Strait Talk
achievements.description: As Hormuz, have at least 10 diplomatic reputation
achievements.requirements:
- *Not* playing as a released vassal
- Is Hormuz
- Has at least 10 diplomatic reputation
achievements.notes:
Diplomatic reputation is gained from Hormuz ideas and completing missions. 
Easier since 1.24 since one of Islam's taxation policies gives +1 
Diplomatic reputation.

achievements.name: Sailor Mon
achievements.description: As Pegu, have at least 100,000 sailors.
achievements.requirements: Have at least 100,000 sailors
achievements.notes:
The achievement needs 100k sailors in the sailor pool. The maximum sailors 
don't matter. Exploiting production development in coastal provinces 
generates sailors even if the maximum has already been reached, but this 
reduces the maximum, so it is only useful if 100k can actually be reached 
in this way.

achievements.name: Lucky Lucca
achievements.description: As Lucca, own Lucknow!
achievements.requirements:
- *Not* playing as a released vassal
- Is Lucca
- Own and core Lucknow
achievements.notes: Lucknow is in northern India, initially owned by Jaunpur.

achievements.name: Komnenoi Empire
achievements.description: As Trebizond, have the Empire government rank.
achievements.requirements:
- *Not* playing as a released vassal
- Is Trebizond
- Is empire
achievements.notes:
Possible tactics include trying to become the emperor of the HRE or 
culture-shifting to Bulgarian and enacting Bulgarian Tsardom government, as 
these will immediately make you an empire.

achievements.name: Kinslayer
achievements.description:
As Tver, Yaroslavl, Ryazan, Beloozero, Rostov or Odoyev, eliminate all 
other Rurikovich nations without changing your ruling dynasty.
achievements.startingConditions:
Playing as *either*: 

- Odoyev
- Ryazan
- Tver
- Yaroslavl
- Beloozero
- Rostov
achievements.requirements:
This country and its junior partners are the only countries with the 
Rurikovich dynasty

achievements.name: True Heir of Timur
achievements.description: Starting as a Timurid subject, form the Mughals and conquer India by 1550.
achievements.startingConditions:
- Playing as one of the following: 
- Afghanistan
- Sistan
- Transoxiana
- Khorasan
- Fars
achievements.requirements:
- Is Mughals
- The year is before 1550
- Every province in India superregion is owned by the country or a 
subject other than a tributary
achievements.notes:
Easier in recent patches than when added. The strongest contenders are 
Afghanistan, which is the closest to India, and Transoxiana, which starts 
the strongest. Recommended ideas include Administrative for extremely cheap 
coring and Diplomatic to manage aggressive expansion and to truce break 
more easily if necessary.

achievements.name: The Three Mountains
achievements.description: Own or have a subject own the entire world as Ryukyu.
achievements.startingConditions:
- Playing as Ryukyu
- *Not* using a random New World.
achievements.requirements:
- The only existing countries are: 
- the player's country,
- Ryukyu and its subjects, but *not*tributary states.
achievements.notes:
Note that it is possible to form another country, but only if you do a true 
one-tag (ruling the world directly without vassals or colonial subjects). 
If you stay Ryukyu, subjects are allowed.

achievements.name: Hoarder
achievements.description: As a Fetishist nation, have 13 available Cults.
achievements.startingConditions:
- Religion is Fetishist
- No restriction of the start date
achievements.requirements:
- Is Fetishist
- Have unlocked 13 Fetishist cults
achievements.notes:
With the Cradle of Civilization DLC activated, Kilwa may convert all of 
Madagascar to Islam once they gain more than 50% trade power in Zanzibar, 
making the achievement impossible if the three Malagasy cults have not been 
gained already.

achievements.name: For the Emperor!
achievements.description:
Form Prussia or Germany, have the Empire government rank and 40.000 
Marines raised at the same time.
achievements.requirements:
- Is Prussia*or*Germany
- Is an empire
- Has at least 40 marine regiments
achievements.notes:
- One of

achievements.name: The First Toungoo Empire
achievements.description: As Taungu, unite the Burman culture group by 1500.
achievements.requirements:
- The year is before 1500
- Is Taungu
- All provinces in the *Burman*culture group are owned by Taungu

achievements.name: Rags and Riches
achievements.description:
Have the highest income in the world while neither owning nor starting 
with a province with a development level higher than 10.
achievements.startingConditions: - No owned province has more than 10 development at the start of the game
achievements.requirements:
- No owned province has more than 10 development
- No other country has a higher income than this country
achievements.notes:
One possible start is Norway. Stay as a vassal under Denmark for 
protection, rush expansion ideas, then get exploration after you reach 
diplomatic tech 7, and colonize Newfoundland from there, triggering the 
Grand Banks Fisheries which will power your colonial nation of Vinland. 
After Vinland forms, you can release and choose to play as them well within 
the time-frame of Denmark beginning integration, bypassing the PU. From 
there, expand and build as many manufactories as possible, swapping into 
Canada or Quebec's ideas, or even the USA. An important thing to note is 
that you can have a 10+ development province after the start of the 
campaign, but not during the month you're trying to count the highest 
income. 

A great alternative start is Wolgast. Play the regular HRE game, expanding 
into Denmark and Russia. Exploit all provinces within 10-20 development 
(requires Cradle of Civilization), boost development of all provinces below 
10. Eventually, your income from flat 10 dev provinces will be the highest 
in the world, especially if you consider expanding into the west and taking 
control over the Channel. Keep all high dev provinces like Lübeck under 
vassals. 

Another good variant is Kilwa. Having Feudalism makes your country a 
dominant power in region, and you can easily expand. Almost all conquered 
provinces have development below 11 dev, so you will not need to exploit 
them (it takes much time). You can get 5 provinces with gold at the start 
and another 2 in Ethiopia. Other provinces also have good resources like 
ivory. Also your home trade nodes (Zanzibar and Cape) are convenient for 
collecting – you can increase income by steering trade from India and 
Malacca. At the start you should rush to admin tech 5 and get colonists for 
colonizing coasts (especially Cape) before the Europeans. 

The game does its check for highest income on every monthly tick meaning 
you could release nations from all your provinces with more than ten 
development and still get the achievement even if the next monthly tick 
would see your income drop tremendously as long as on the previous month 
tick, you had the highest income.

achievements.name: Gothic Invasion
achievements.description: Start as Theodoro and conquer all Germanic culture provinces in Europe.
achievements.requirements:
- *Not* playing as a released vassal
- All provinces with *Germanic* culture group in Europe owned by Theodoro
- Culture is either: 
- *Gothic* from the Byzantine culture group
- *Gothic* from the Germanic culture group
achievements.notes:
Forming other nations will make this achievement much more difficult, 
because then all *Germanic* cultured provinces in Europe have to be 
converted to another culture to fulfill the requirements. This does not 
apply if the formed country is a Former colonial nation formable and 
Theodoro still has provinces in the old world, because forming such a 
country as Theodoro keeps Theodoro alive so the achievement can still be 
fulfilled by feeding all *Germanic* provinces in Europe to Theodoro if they 
are later vassalized. Note though that playing as a released colonial 
nation doesn't work, because it counts as playing as a released vassal.

achievements.name: On the Edge of Madness
achievements.description: As Aztecs, reach 95 Doom, then go 20 years without Doom hitting 100.
achievements.startingConditions:
- Playing as Aztec
- *Not* using a random New World
achievements.requirements:
- *Not* playing as a released vassal
- Reach 95 Doom, then survive for 20 years without hitting 100 Doom. Had 
the flag *doom_reached_95* for 20 years *and* do not have flag 
*doom_reached_100*
achievements.notes:
It is not required to keep doom between 95 and 100 for 20 years, but make 
sure you are at 95 doom at least once when a month tick happens so the 
countdown actually starts. Doom may drop below 95 at any time. Passing 
religious reforms (except the Reform Religion button, which disables doom) 
will also not prevent the achievement. Changing religion (e.g. to mayan or 
animist) after hitting 95 doom will also not prevent the achievement.

achievements.name: Cherrypicking
achievements.description: Conscript a 3 star general from a Daimyo Subject.
achievements.requirements: Conscript a 3-star general from a Daimyo subject
achievements.notes:
The most reliable way is to vassalize a Jurchen tribe and make them fulfill 
their mission Unite the Jurchen Tribes which gives a 3-star general as a 
reward. This can be done in under a month by creating a custom nation 
shogun, releasing a Jurchen subject and feeding them the required 
provinces. 

Approach via Manchurian general is not doable since the Domination DLC as 
the mission tree was changed and it requires forming Manchu - Manchu cannot 
be formed by a daimyo or any subject other than tributary states.

achievements.name: On the Rhodes Again
achievements.description:
Starting as The Knights, conquer and core Constantinople, Jerusalem and 
Antioch.
achievements.startingConditions:
- Playing as The Knights
- *Not* using a random New World
achievements.requirements:
Own and core the provinces of Constantinople (151), Antioch (2313) and 
Jerusalem (379)

achievements.name: Yarr Harr a Pirate's Life For Me
achievements.description: Choose to play as New Providence and conquer all of Caribbeans.
achievements.startingConditions:
- No more than 1 custom nation exists in the world
- Used no more than 201 nation designer points if playing as a custom 
nation
achievements.requirements:
- Is New Providence
- Owns all provinces in the Caribbean region.
achievements.notes:
Bermuda is in the Caribbean region also. 

- Starting as a custom nation in the Caribbean with the Bahamas as a 
core, and privateering in the Caribbean will allow you to spawn New 
Providence extremely quickly, giving you time to expand and colonize much 
of the Caribbean before the European colonial powers arrive. Pirate 
republics can declare war on colonial nations without their overlord being 
called as an ally, so if Europeans begin to colonize the Caribbean before 
you can finish, it may be easier to allow a colonial nation to form.

achievements.name: Tatarstan
achievements.description: As Kazan or Nogai, own all Tatar culture group lands.
achievements.requirements:
- *Not* playing as a released vassal
- Is Kazan or Nogai
- No *Tatar* culture group province is owned by another country

achievements.name: Sleepless in Seattle
achievements.description: Own 10 Coffee producing provinces, and have your capital in Salish.
achievements.requirements:
- Capital is Salish (874)
- Own 10 Coffee producing provinces
achievements.notes:
Easiest to complete as a New World nation, as this will simplify moving 
your capital and help with attacking colonial nations. Coffee has an 
increased chance to be produced in the Brazil, Caribbean and Colombia 
colonial regions.

achievements.name: Rekindling the Flames
achievements.description:
Starting as a Zoroastrian custom nation with no more than 200 points and a 
maximum of 5 provinces, rekindle the royal fires.
achievements.startingConditions:
- Playing as a custom nation
- Only 1 custom nation exists in the world
- Used no more than 201 nation designer points
- No more than 5 provinces
- Is Zoroastrian
achievements.requirements:
- *Not* playing as a released vassal
- Is Zoroastrian
- Has country modifier *Royal Fires*
achievements.notes:
Note that this achievement cannot be combined with Keep the Flame Burning 
because it requires being a Custom Nation, which disallows earning Keep the 
Flame Burning.

-

achievements.name: No Trail of Tears
achievements.description:
Own and have cores on the Thirteen Colonies as Cherokee with all 
institutions embraced.
achievements.startingConditions:
- Playing as Cherokee
- *Not* using a random New World.
achievements.requirements:
- Have embraced all institutions.
- Own and core all provinces in the areas: Westsylvania, Delaware Valley, 
Hudson Valley, Massachusetts, Connecticut, Virginia, Great Valley, Piedmont 
Plateau, North Carolina, South Carolina, Vandalia and Overmountain.
- Own and core the provinces: Guale, Penobscott, Shatteras, Mocama, 
Coweta, Sokoki, Kennebec, Passamaquoddy.

achievements.name: First Come, First Serve
achievements.description:
Starting as a Western technology custom nation in North America or South 
America with no more than 200 points, unite the two continents.
achievements.startingConditions:
- Playing as a custom nation
- Only 1 custom nation exists in the world
- Used no more than 201 nation designer points
- *Not* using a random New World.
- Is in western technology group
- Capital is on the North or South American continent.
achievements.requirements:
- *Not* playing as a released vassal
- Owns or has a core on all habitable land provinces in the continents 
of North and South America
achievements.notes:
There must not be any empty provinces in the Americas, but it is not 
necessary to finish the colonies. Let the Colonial Nations do most of the 
job; their overlords will usually not defend them in a war. Only native 
provinces give overextension; this means you are able to annex the Colonial 
Nations in one war, but do the war before they break free. Provinces which 
you own don't have to be cored, so you can leave provinces uncored if they 
don't give OE. When designing your custom nation, by far the most important 
idea you can choose to include is the (unrecognized string “may establish 
siberian frontiers” for Template:Icon)*May establish Siberian frontiers* 
diplomatic idea, since frontiers aren't limited in number in the same way 
that standard colonization is: this will allow you to expand extremely 
rapidly across the continent at the cost of diplomatic power.

achievements.name: Sakoku Law
achievements.description: Go full isolationist in 6 Incidents.
achievements.requirements: Isolationism achievement counter is 6
achievements.notes:
By "going full isolationist" the game is *not* referring to the level of 
isolationism in your country. Rather, it's referring to the fact that each 
incident has an outcome of either open, neutral, or isolationist. To get 
the achievement you must get the isolationist outcome of 6 incidents.

- 
-

achievements.name: The Buddhists Strike Back
achievements.description: As Kotte or Kandy, own all of India and convert it to Theravada Buddhism.
achievements.requirements:
- *Not* playing as a released vassal
- Own and core all of the provinces in the Indian sub-continent.
- All of the provinces in the Indian sub-continent are Theravada
achievements.notes:
Taking the province of Pataliputra will give an extra missionary. The 
monuments Bagan Temples and Buddha Statues give additional missionaries. If 
playing as Kandy, you'll likely also get the achievement Cotton Kandy.

achievements.name: KHAAAAAAN
achievements.description: Restore the Mongol Empire before the Age of Absolutism.
achievements.requirements:
- It is *not* the Age of Absolutism or the Age of Revolutions
- Is the Mongol Empire

achievements.name: Jihad
achievements.description: As Najd, own 500 Sunni provinces.
achievements.startingConditions:
- Playing as Najd
- Religion is Sunni
achievements.requirements:
- Own *500* provinces with Sunni religion
- Is Sunni
achievements.notes:
Easier to achieve as many new provinces were added to the game since 
release.

achievements.name: Frozen Assets
achievements.description:
Start as Novgorod and control 90% of the trade power in the White Sea 
trade node while it is the highest valued trade node in the world.
achievements.requirements:
Have 90% trade share in White Sea and it's the highest valued trade node 
in the world.
achievements.notes:
- Note that "highest valued trade" means Total trade value *minus* 
outgoing trade.
- Not too difficult once you become powerful. You should be able to 
steer most Asian trade towards the white sea. Trade and plutocratic ideas 
can be helpful, but are not necessary : trade companies, the Great Russian 
Federation reform, and monuments like Bam citadel will provide you as many 
merchants as you need. Building manufactories (not workshops) in downstream 
nodes like Girin, Beijing, Yumen, etc. will increase the trade value 
downstream drastically. Note that England gets an event (« The Muscovite 
trade company ») that gives them permanent +20 trade power in the White 
Sea ̦; it can be counterbalanced by building lots of light ships.

achievements.name: Albania or Iberia
achievements.description: As Albania, own or have a subject own Iberia and the Caucasus.
achievements.requirements:
- *Not* playing as a released vassal
- All provinces in the Iberia and Caucasia regions are owned by the 
player's country *or* its non-tributary subjects.

achievements.name: The White Company
achievements.description:
Join a war on the other side of someone to whom you have rented 
condottieri.
achievements.requirements:
Join a war against a nation that you hire out condottieri to. Have the 
country flag *white_company*
achievements.notes:
As you don't have to accept a call to arms for a few months the easiest way 
to do this is when one of your allies asks you to join a war, first rent 
out condottieri to one of their enemies in the war then accept the call to 
arms.

- 
-

achievements.name: Østindisk Kompagni Te
achievements.description: As Denmark establish Trade company and have at least 10% Tea market share.
achievements.requirements:
- Is Denmark*or*Scandinavia
- Has at least one province in Asia assigned to a trade company
- Has 10% market share in Tea
achievements.notes:
Easiest when Denmark chooses exploration ideas early to reach Southeast 
Asia. Then form a claim in Ayutthaya or wait for Mingsplosion.

*or*

achievements.name: Cities of Cibola
achievements.description:
As a Nation that has Pueblo as primary culture, own at least 7 provinces 
with 10 development each.
achievements.requirements: Own 7 provinces with at least 10 development each
achievements.notes:
Need to reform your nation before you are able to manually develop 
provinces. Use Settle down reform to be able to own more then one province 
and settle tribal development into your provinces.

achievements.name: Blood for the Sky God!
achievements.description: As a Tengri nation, have Nahuatl as your syncretic faith.
achievements.requirements:
- Is Tengri
- Syncretic faith is Nahuatl
achievements.notes:
Start as a Jurchen tribe and choose Exploration ideas first. Conquer Eastern 
Siberia for colonial range to North America and colony-hop to Mesoamerica. 
Do *not* form Qing.

achievements.name: Venetian Sea
achievements.description:
Have a 75% Trade share in both the Alexandria and Constantinople nodes as 
Venice, owning less than 10 cities.
achievements.requirements:
- *Not* playing as a released vassal
- Have less than 10 fully colonized provinces(cities)
- Have at least *75%* of the total trade power in the trade nodes 
Alexandria and Constantinople
achievements.notes:
Quickly vassalize Byzantium, feed them back their cores, ally 
Austria/Hungary to combat the Ottomans early game. Conquer all the centers 
of trade/estuaries in the Constantinople trade node and feed them to 
Byzantium. You can release Bulgaria and feed them as well so Byzantium does 
not have as high development. Repeat this by releasing Syria and feeding 
them back their cores and conquering/feeding Syria centers of trade in 
Alexandria node. Keep vassals happy by developing their provinces, 
placating and developing your own provinces to make yourself seem stronger. 
Plutocratic/Influence/Diplomatic/Innovative ideas help with keeping vassals 
loyal because of ideas, policies and diplomatic reputation. Take Trade idea 
group. You can drop Crete, Corfu and Dalmacija and pick up Milan and 
Ragusa. Release Croatia to help control the Ragusa trade node to ensure 
your wealth.

achievements.name: Emperor of Hindustan
achievements.description: Starting as Delhi, Restore their Empire's borders.
achievements.requirements:
The following provinces are owned by the country *or* its non-tributary 
subjects:
achievements.notes:
Avoid the event at the start of the game that attempts to free Sirhind by 
using the 'place relative on throne' subject interaction right away. To 
make them loyal you can do development in their land, remember that it 
costs 0 dip to integrate them as you already start with cores. Focus on 
expanding south and northwest to begin the game. 

Alternatively, get lots of allies and let the event fire. Sirhind will 
attack you without any allies such as Jaunpur. Right before confirming the 
independence war option in the event, concentrate development from 
Sirhind's provinces, so you can fully annex it in the peace deal. 

Provinces owned by vassals and other non-tributary subjects of the player's 
country will count for the achievement.

achievements.name: Choson One
achievements.description:
As Korea, own or have a subject own all Shinto, Confucian and Buddhist 
provinces in the world.
achievements.requirements:
All provinces following an Eastern religion are owned by Korea*or* its 
non-tributary subjects.
achievements.notes:
The Eastern religions are Theravada, Vajrayana, Mahayana, Confucian, and 
Shinto. Due to Ming's size and power it is best to become their tributary 
and go after all other nations around before attempting to attack them. 

The province Kuma (2417) in the Pontic Steppe can turn Vajrayana Vajrayana 
due to the event which spawns Kalmyk.

achievements.name: Back to the Piast
achievements.description: As Mazovia, Glogow or Opole, form the nation of Poland.
achievements.startingConditions:
Playing as *either*: 

- Mazovia
- Silesia
- Opole
- Glogow
achievements.requirements:
- *Not* playing as a released vassal
- Is Poland

achievements.name: Turn the Table
achievements.description:
As a colony, break free and vassalize your former overlord without forming 
any other nation.
achievements.requirements:
- Playing as a former colonial nation
- Vassalize the former owner of the colonial nation
achievements.notes:
- Forming another country as the colonial nation *will* prevent this 
achievement even if that country is a colonial formable like USA or 
Australia.
- Easily done as Ternate. Colonize Australia to the point where a 
colonial nation forms. Release them and select 'Play As', then vassalize 
your former overlord.

achievements.name: The Sudanese Expedition
achievements.description: Starting as Morocco, conquer the Niger and Sahel Regions.
achievements.requirements: Own all of the Niger and Sahel regions
achievements.notes:
*For the event see: The Sudanese Expedition.*

The initial crossing of the Sahara can be done by mission so you don't need 
to take a colonial idea group first. Later, the provinces of Yola, Wukari, 
Bauchi, and Djado do NOT need to be fully colonized, building a colony will 
suffice.

achievements.name: Sunset Invasion
achievements.description:
Own and have cores on Lisbon, Madrid, Paris, London, Amsterdam and Rome as 
the Aztecs.
achievements.requirements:
Own and core the provinces of Lisboa, Madrid, Paris, London, Amsterdam, 
and Roma.
achievements.notes:
As a New World country European overlords will not automatically join 
defensive wars against their colonies by you, establish a power base in 
North America, then you can either get allies (unlikely as most will desire 
your gold provinces too much) or an effective strategy is try to trigger a 
defensive war, or attack a colonial province still controlled by the 
overlord. In the following peace treaty take European provinces from them, 
that way you can easily ship over your elite troops in peace time without
