the need to also build up a large armada. With the Unrestricted Conquest ability 
from the Age of Revolutions you can take any province making it easy to 
take capitals without the need of conquering a lot of adjacent provinces.

achievements.name: Saladin's Legacy
achievements.description: Playing as Hisn Kayfa, reforge the Ayyubid Empire.
achievements.requirements: Own the following provinces:
achievements.notes:
You will most likely not be able to ally the Ottomans at start. One 
strategy is to restart until Aq Qoyunlu is friendly, and allying them along 
with. Try to ally Ajam, Mamluks and attack Qara Qoyunlu together. You can 
ally these two at start. If they pick QQ as a rival, and you pick "Lenient 
taxation" Iqta ability (that gives +1 diplomatic reputation; requires Cradle 
of Civilization).

achievements.name: Chop Chop
achievements.description: With only one Monarch, have six different Consorts.
achievements.startingConditions:
- No more than 1 custom nation exists in the world
- Used no more than 201 nation designer points if playing as a custom 
nation
achievements.requirements: - Have six different consorts
achievements.notes:
As an Anglican nation, (a) Divorce Consort every 100 church power, then 
wait for a new consort; (b) royal marriage with another nation; or (c) 
press "Marry a local Noblewoman" button in religious panel. Cycle through 
the options five times. Disinherit the heir if necessary. Easily doable if 
the ruler is young.

- 
-

achievements.name: Brick by Brick
achievements.description:
Starting as Denmark, enact the Unified Kalmar Monarchy government reform 
and own the entire Scandinavian region as your cores.
achievements.requirements:
- Has enacted the Unified Kalmar Monarchy government reform
- Own and core all provinces in the Scandinavia region
achievements.notes:
Make sure that you always have at least one junior partner in Scandinavia, 
because otherwise you will lose the starting reform Kalmar Union, because 
you can only get the reform Unified Kalmar Monarchy by completing the 
mission Ratify the Kalmar Union while having the reform Kalmar Union.

achievements.name: The Last Crusade
achievements.description:
Starting as Byzantium, control Venezia, and make sure that the country 
Venice doesn't exist.
achievements.requirements:
- Is Byzantium or the Roman Empire
- Owns core province Venezia (112)
- Venice does *not* exist
- has never formed the Latin Empire[1]
achievements.notes:
Reforming Byzantium from another country does not allow for the 
achievement.

achievements.name: Terra Mariana
achievements.description: As Riga, own or have a subject own the Baltic region.
achievements.requirements:
- *Not* playing as a released vassal
- Is Riga
- All provinces in the Baltic region are owned by the player's country 
*or* its non-tributary subjects.

achievements.name: Rise of the White Sheep
achievements.description: As Aq Qoyunlu, own Tabriz and have Qara Qoyunlu not exist by 1478.
achievements.requirements:
- The year is before 1478
- Qara Qoyunlu does *not* exist
- Owns Tabriz
achievements.notes:
As long as you own Tabriz, any other provinces owned by Qara Qoyunlu at 
game start can be owned by other nations. Vassal/ally feeding can be 
useful. Iraq has many cores on the required area, and there are several 
nations that can be released from Qara Qoyunlu's provinces.

achievements.name: Restore the Pentarchy
achievements.description:
Starting as Byzantium, own Rome, Constantinople, Alexandria, Antioch, and 
Jerusalem while being Orthodox.
achievements.startingConditions:
- Playing as Byzantium
- Religion is Orthodox
achievements.requirements:
- Is Byzantium or the Roman Empire
- Religion is Orthodox
- The following provinces are cored and follow the Orthodox faith: 
- Roma (118)
- Constantinople (151)
- Alexandria (358)
- Antioch (2313)
- Jerusalem (379)
- has never formed the Latin Empire[1]

achievements.name: Lessons of Hemmingstedt
achievements.description:
As Dithmarschen, hold the provinces of Sjaelland and Holland while Denmark 
do not exist.
achievements.requirements:
- Denmark does *not* exist
- Own the provinces of Sjælland (12) and Amsterdam (97)

achievements.name: Lazarus
achievements.description: As Serbia, own the entire Balkans as core provinces.
achievements.requirements:
- *Not* playing as a released vassal
- Is Serbia
- Own and core all provinces in the Balkans region

achievements.name: Keep the Flame Burning
achievements.description:
As a Zoroastrian nation, own all Religious Centers and Monument Baku 
Ateshgah on tier 3.
achievements.requirements:
- Religion is Zoroastrian
- Baku Ateshgah is tier 3
- The following provinces are owned and follow the Zoroastrian faith: 
- Daman (4430)
- Khiva (441)
- Larestan (2223)
- Shirvan (421)
- Tun (4336)
- Zanjan (2212)
achievements.notes:
Easiest after forming Persia, which can convert to Zoroastrian via mission 
even if no provinces of the religion are left. 

Note that this achievement cannot be combined with Rekindling the Flames 
because it cannot be earned as a Custom Nation, which is required for 
Rekindling the Flames.

achievements.name: Auld Alliance Reversed
achievements.description: As Scotland, have France as a vassal (do not form Great Britain).
achievements.requirements:
- *Not* playing as a released vassal.
- France is a vassal of Scotland.

achievements.name: Turtles all the way down
achievements.description: As Korea get 135% Ship Durability.
achievements.requirements: Ship durability is at least 135%.
achievements.notes:
The most straightforward way to get this achievement is by becoming the 
Emperor of China and enacting the "Promote Naval Officers" celestial empire 
decree for +20% durability. Combine this with Koreas national ideas (+10%) 
and their Naval doctrine (+5%) for exactly 135% durability. 

Alternative sources of durability are : waiting until you have a ruler with 
the "navigator" personality (which gives +10% ship durability) and taking 
either either or both naval and quality ideas.

achievements.name: The Prince of Egypt
achievements.description: Starting as Florence, form Egypt.
achievements.requirements: Is Egypt
achievements.notes:
Forming Egypt normally requires Admin tech 20, but it's possible to bypass 
this by forming the Mamluks and completing their missions (this will 
require becoming Muslim to take Iqta government, though). One intermediate 
tag that may be useful is Jerusalem, since it gives claims on most of the 
Egyptian culture lands. 

You can also play a normal campaign (even form Italy) then release and play 
as the mamluks, achieve independence and form Egypt at the end. You can go 
as far to make a backup save so you can continue as Italy normally, if you 
please.

achievements.name: Neither Holy, Nor German
achievements.description: Have 7 Free Cities in the Empire, none of which is of a Germanic culture.
achievements.requirements:
- Is emperor of the Holy Roman Empire
- There are least *7* countries which: 
- 
- have the government reform Free City
- have a primary culture which is *not* in the *Germanic* culture 
group
achievements.notes:
- There can be germanic free cities, but there have to be at least 7 
non-germanic ones
- You can release OPM client states that are republics. Make sure they 
dislike you before granting them independence, which actually raises their 
opinion of you. They will then accept free city status.

achievements.name: Great Moravia
achievements.description: Restore the Great Moravian borders as Nitra or Moravia.
achievements.requirements:
- Is Nitra, Moravia*or*Great Moravia
- Own and core the following provinces:
achievements.notes:
Nitra's cores don't expire except by culture conversion. Requires all the 
territory of Bohemia, Glogow and Opole, Wien (134), Manhartsberg (1770), 
Traungau (4761) and Wienerwald (4762) from Austria, Kraków (262) and Nowy 
Sącz (2960) from Poland, and the Slovakia and Transdanubia areas from 
Hungary. 

If choosing to play as Moravia, you will incur much more agresssive 
expansion and find it harder to make alliances due to being a heretic 
nation (Hussite) if you release them on day 1. There are advantages to 
starting in the empire though, so you may find it useful to convert some of 
Moravia's cores to Catholic before switching to them. 

Since this achievement demands the release of a nation it doesn't have the 
"started as" protection. In return the easiest way to achieve this is to 
play Hungary or Austria, get all the lands, release Nitra and grant it all 
provinces. Reabsorb it once possible and release to play as. The deed will 
be done. This works for any of the create or release achievements and turns 
these deeds trivial. 

Since Winds of change, this achievement is doable simply by forming Greater 
Moravia, which can be done by Bohemia.

achievements.name: Golden Horn
achievements.description:
As a Somali nation, fully own the Horn of Africa region and have a monthly 
gold income of at least 10 ducats.
achievements.requirements:
- All provinces of the Horn of Africa region are owned by the player's 
country *or* its non-tributary subjects.
- Have 10 income from gold
achievements.notes:
- Note that the provinces of Fazughli, Afder and Ogaden have to be 
colonized for the achievement, but the colonies do not need to be complete. 
You can just send your colonist to all 3 provinces at once as soon as you 
have the other land.
- Start as Adal or Ajuuraan, and set the National Focus to 
administrative, then swiftly conquer all adjacent nations in the region 
that are smaller than you. Aggressive Expansion will not be an issue due 
to the nations belonging to different religious groups. To attain the gold 
income, improve production development in the gold provinces Kaffa (2757) 
and Damot (2762).
- Convert the religion in the gold provinces to your state religion, 
which will increase your gold income, requiring less development.

achievements.name: David the Builder
achievements.description: As Georgia have no free building slots in any owned province.
achievements.requirements:
- Is Georgia
- No owned provinces have a free building slot
achievements.notes:
Playing or starting as Imereti is not required anymore. 

Can be done by filling the capital with buildings and then giving all other 
provinces to vassals. The capital Tbilisi starts with 3 building slots, so 
it may be preferable to move the capital to one of the Western provinces 
since they have only 2 available buildings slots, making it possible to 
fill with just a church and a marketplace (100 100 ducats each) at tech 4 
in admin/dip. 

Can also be achieved by being fully annexed. Simply declare No-CB wars on 
your neighbors and surrender until you cease existing.

achievements.name: Sikh Pun
achievements.description: Convert to Sikhism and form the nation of Punjab.
achievements.requirements:
- Is Punjab
- Religion is Sikh
achievements.notes:
Aside from forming Punjab, releasing Punjab as a vassal and playing it and 
converting to Sikh is also possible.

achievements.name: Holy Trinity
achievements.description:
As the Papacy, own Jerusalem and have Livonian Order, Teutonic Order and 
The Knights as Marches.
achievements.requirements:
- is The Papal State
- Own and core Jerusalem.
- Have Livonian Order, Teutonic Order and The Knights as marches.
achievements.notes:
This achievement has several common pitfalls which would make it all but 
impossible to complete it if they happen. The strategy page for this 
achievement has a section which explains them and some ways to get out of 
these situations. The player is advised to read that before attempting the 
achievement.

achievements.name: Good King René
achievements.description: Start as Provence, form the Kingdom of Jerusalem.
achievements.requirements: Is Jerusalem
achievements.notes:
Note that the Kingdom of Jerusalem cannot be formed after Age of 
Reformation ends.

achievements.name: For Odin!
achievements.description:
Starting as a Norse custom nation with no more than 200 points and a 
maximum of 5 provinces, own & core Scandinavia and the British Isles and 
convert it all to Norse.
achievements.startingConditions:
- Playing as a custom nation
- Only 1 custom nation exists in the world
- Used no more than 201 nation designer points
- No more than 5 provinces
- Religion is Norse
achievements.requirements:
- *Not* playing as a released vassal
- Religion is Norse
- Own and core all provinces in Britain and Scandinavia.
- All provinces in Britain and Scandinavia have Norse religion.

Britain and Scandinavia
achievements.notes:
Can also be paired with From Humble Origins and Ideas Guy

-

achievements.name: Dracula's Revenge
achievements.description:
Start as Wallachia or Moldavia, form Romania and own or have a subject own 
all of the Balkans.
achievements.requirements:
- Is Romania
- *Not* playing as a released vassal
- All provinces in the Balkans region are owned by Romania*or* its 
non-tributary subjects.
achievements.notes: Possible starts are Moldavia and Wallachia

achievements.name: African Power
achievements.description: Own and have cores on all provinces in Africa as Kongo.
achievements.requirements: All fully colonized provinces in Africa are owned and cored by Kongo
achievements.notes:
- Empty provinces and unfinished colonies are excluded and may be safely 
ignored.
- The isolated islands required are: Comoros, Mahe, Mauritius, Île 
Bourbon, Sao Tome, Fernando Po, St. Helena, Cape Verde and Djerba (but not 
the Canarias, Madeira, Azores, Maldives, Socotra, or any other in the 
Mediterranean).

achievements.name: A Hero’s Welcome
achievements.description: Starting as Karaman, form the Sultanate of Rum.
achievements.requirements: Is Rûm
achievements.notes:
Initial moves for a success are for the player to ally Mamluks and later 
when possible Timurids. Expanding East and land locking the Ottomans in the 
Anatolia region by quick expansion east and north will in conjunction with 
your powerful allies forces the Ottomans to expand into Europe, once this 
occurs your best chance is to wait for a good opportunity strike with your 
allies when the ottomans are weak. Your main objective should be to get the 
provinces of Kocaeli and Biga, so that in next war you can build up your 
galley navy and block the straits.

achievements.name: One Faith
achievements.description: Have all non-wasteland land provinces in the world be of your religion.
achievements.requirements:
No colonized non-wasteland province has a different religion than this 
country.
achievements.notes:
- Using the random new world will drastically reduce the number of 
provinces, especially inland ones, making this easier than with the true 
new world.
- Uncolonized provinces may still be of a different religion.

The easiest choice is either Austria or Ottomans, as both tags can conquer 
the world easily and have religions that have lots of missionaries and 
missionary strength buffs. The hardest faiths to One Faith with are the 
Pagan faiths (Animist, Tengri…), and Confucian with Mandate of Heaven. If 
playing as a Fetishist or Hindu nation, choose Buddhadharma or Buddha, 
respectively, to be able to use the Buddha statues and Pagan temples. Najd 
is a possible starting nation, since its ideas are religiously focused, 
including access to +2 missionaries and +2% missionary strength, as well as 
its starting religion of Sunni granting *−2%* local missionary strength 
which would make these provinces harder to convert. Possible to combine 
with Jihad.

achievements.name: This is fine
achievements.description:
Have at least +10 Global Unrest and be in a winning coalition war, which 
was targeted against you.
achievements.requirements:
- National unrest is at least *+10*
- Is the defending war leader in a punitive war and has at least *+30%* 
war score in that war
achievements.notes:
The national unrest can be seen in the stability tab. 

Start as England, declare no-CB wars on two Irish nations. White peace them 
ASAP. One of them shall be Ulster as it controls the Irish part of the 
strait and it is important to be able to block the strait during the 
coalition war. Other Irish nations and Scotland should create a coalition 
against you. Delete your armies. When they declare the coalition war on 
you, block the strait at Ayshire, then occupy Scotland. This should give 
you enough warscore; if not, beat some of their armies. Wait for the War of 
the Roses disaster to fire, which should give enough unrest (altogether 
with war exhaustion and −3 stability). Can be done in 4 years, depending on 
how quick the coalition war fires. Can also be done in combination with To 
the Bone. Start as Bone and declare no-CB wars on your two immediate 
neighbours, pillage their capitals, truce break and repeat. When you reach 
-3 stability stab up once and continue. This will give a high war 
exhaustion and a coalition should form against you. 

The warscore condition in this achievement is bugged in versions 1.35 and 
1.36 and can't reliably be fulfilled. In some cases it triggers randomly 
even if the warscore is lower.

achievements.name: The Sun Never Sets on the Indian Empire
achievements.description:
Form Hindustan or Bharat and own or have a subject own Cape, London, Hong 
Kong (Canton) and Ottawa (Kichessipirini).
achievements.requirements:
- *Not* playing as a released vassal
- Is Hindustan or Bharat
- Own or have a non-tributary subject own London (236), Cape (1177), 
Canton (667) and Kichessipirini (4890)
achievements.notes:
Kichessipirini (4890) is called Ottawa when owned by a British or English 
country.

achievements.name: Parisian Pasha
achievements.description: Assign Pasha to Paris.
achievements.requirements:
- Has a government reform which allows Pashas
- Paris has a pasha
achievements.notes:
Can be done as either Ottomans or Rûm

Possible reforms are Ottoman Government, Modernized Ottoman Government, Reorganized 
Ottoman Government and Sultanate of Rûm

achievements.name: Mary of Lotharingia
achievements.description: Starting as Burgundy, form Lotharingia and have a female ruler named Marie.
achievements.startingConditions:
- Playing as Burgundy
- *Not* using a random New World
achievements.requirements:
- Is Lotharingia
- ruler is female
- ruler's name is *Marie*
achievements.notes:
A Consort Regency led by a consort named Marie also qualifies for the 
achievement.

achievements.name: Hessian Mercenaries
achievements.description: As Hesse, have at least 50 regiments of mercenaries and no loans.
achievements.requirements:
- *Not* playing as a released vassal
- is Hesse
- Have 50 regiments of mercenaries
- Have no loans

achievements.name: Barbarossa
achievements.description: As a Maghrebi nation, have 500 light ships privateering at the same time.
achievements.requirements: has at least 500 ships privateering
achievements.notes:
- One of
- 
- 
- 
-

achievements.name: From Humble Origins
achievements.description:
Starting as a custom nation with no more than 50 points, have at least 
2000 total development.
achievements.startingConditions:
- Playing as a custom nation
- Only 1 custom nation exists in the world
- Used no more than 51 nation designer points
achievements.requirements:
- *Not* playing as a released vassal
- Has at least 2000 total development
achievements.notes:
It is possible to create a custom nation with 2000 development with only 50 
points, although it is very tedious to do so. First, select a capital 
within Central Asia, be a duchy. Get the worst possible ruler, heir, and 
consort, and make them as young as possible. Then, you should pick the 
ideas that cost *negative points*, from most negative points to least (they 
are found under administrative ideas). You should be left with three idea 
slots, which you should fill with administrative ideas that cost no points. 
Finally, take all provinces with the lowest terrain multiplier until you 
have 2000 development. Avoid taking provinces with gold or trade bonuses, 
since they will cost more. 

Can also be paired with For Odin! and Ideas Guy

-

achievements.name: Rozwi Empire
achievements.description: Starting as Butua, conquer Mutapa (Zimbabwe and Lower Zambezi areas).
achievements.requirements:
- Own all provinces in the following areas: 
- Butua
- Lower Zambezi
- Zimbabwe
achievements.notes:
Easy only with Conquest of Paradise or El Dorado DLC. Starting in 1444 you 
can always get Kilwa (and at least one of these: Tumbuka, Maravi, Makua) to 
support your independence. Declare war ASAP and boost your gold production. 

Without either of these DLCs, you're on your own. Save up money and build 
an army when Mutapa has started integrating you.

achievements.name: Queen of Mercury
achievements.description: As Kilwa, own and have cores on Zanzibar and Bombay (Thana).
achievements.requirements:
- Is Kilwa
- Own and core Zanzibar and Thana.
achievements.notes:
- Since Kilwa starts with Zanzibar, essentially the goal is to expand to 
Thana on the west coast of India which is owned by Gujarat at the start of 
the game. If you form any nation, you will be ineligible for the 
achievement.
- Much easier with the Dharma expansion, as you can simply charter Thana 
off its owner.

achievements.name: Land of Eastern Jade
achievements.description: Own a core province in the Mexico region as a Buddhist country.
achievements.requirements:
- Be Theravada, Vajrayana, or Mahayana.
- Own a core province in the region Mexico.
achievements.notes:
An interesting choice is Ayutthaya. Start by choosing exploration ideas, 
colonize the islands in Indonesia, followed by the Marshall Islands, and 
Midway. Then focus on North America, and most likely you can colonize 
Sinaloa, which is the easiest path for this achievement.

achievements.name: The Great Khan
achievements.description:
Starting as Mongolia or Great Horde, own or have a subject own the 
Chinese, Russian and Persian regions.
achievements.requirements:
All provinces in the China subcontinent, and the Pontic Steppe, Russia, 
Ural, Persia and Khorasan regions are owned by the player's country *or* 
its non-tributary subjects.
achievements.notes:
The Caucasia region is not needed even though it gets highlighted by the 
in-game achievement list.

achievements.name: These Banners need a Saga
achievements.description:
Starting as a Jurchen nation, have 100 regiments of Banners raised at the 
same time.
achievements.requirements: Have 100 banner regiments
achievements.notes:
Make a custom Jurchen duchy holding all Jurchen provinces and the most 
developed states in East Asia. Set it up for high number of states, reduced 
culture conversion cost, and lots of diplomatic power. Start with at least 
1200-1250 development, or face needing to develop or conquer more and wait 
for separatism to tick down. Form Manchu and then Qing, then make everyone 
nearby pay tribute in diplomatic power. Everything can be converted to 
Manchu before 1500, which is enough for 100 regiments and a few more. Admin 
tech 8 gives 3 more state slots but it is possible without them.

- 
-

achievements.name: The Bohemians
achievements.description: As Bohemia, own Dublin as a core province.
achievements.requirements:
- *Not* playing as a released vassal
- Is Bohemia
- Own and core Pale

achievements.name: Sons of Carthage
achievements.description:
As Tunisia, own and have cores on Sicily, Sardinia, the Balearic Islands, 
the coast of Algiers and the southern coast of Spain.
achievements.requirements: Own and core the following provinces:

achievements.name: Abu Bakr II’s Ambition
achievements.description: Start as Mali and have 4 Colonial Subjects in South America.
achievements.requirements: Have 4 colonial nations based in the continent of South America
achievements.notes:
All 4 colonies must have their capital on the South American continent. 

Colonial Colombia is partially in South America and North America and 
colonizing the NA lands may result in their capital being in NA.

achievements.name: Carthago Delenda Est
achievements.description:
As an Italian culture nation, make sure entire Tunis Area is at 100 
devastation.
achievements.requirements:
- Culture group is *Latin*
- All provinces in the Tunisia area have 100 devastation
achievements.notes:
Culture must be Latin at game start *and* when Tunisia is devastated. Naples 
is by far the strongest and closest Latin nation in 1444. Regardless of the 
nation selected, declare a war in which land may be taken from Tunis. Take 
the Tunisia area in the war. Then go bankrupt repeatedly until you have 100 
devastation (going bankrupt adds 10 devastation to all provinces). The 
first bankruptcy can be declared manually, but this button can't be used 
while being bankrupt. So the subsequent bankruptcies must be achieved by 
taking the maximum amount of loans and spending all the money while running 
a deficit. A high deficit can be achieved by using the loans to hire and 
upgrade advisors. This is far faster than trying to raise devastation using 
other methods such as occupying the land while at war and using scorch 
earth.

achievements.name: The Uncommonwealth
achievements.description: As Lithuania, become The Commonwealth.
achievements.requirements:
- *Not* playing as a released vassal
- Is Commonwealth
achievements.notes:
Lithuanias missions will give a restoration of Union casus belli against 
Poland, if Lithuania are independent after 1450, rival Poland and have 
annexed all of Livonian Order and Riga

achievements.name: The Ostenders
achievements.description:
As Austria or AH have the District and Military Administration investments 
in the West Bengal area.
achievements.startingConditions:
- Playing as Austria
- No more than 1 custom nation exists in the world
- Used no more than 201 nation designer points
achievements.requirements:
- Owns a province in West Bengal area with the District trade company 
investment
- Owns a province in West Bengal area with the Military Administration 
trade company investment
achievements.notes:
Either conquer or charter Bengal Delta from its owner. Add it to a trade 
company and save up 1,200 ducats. Switch to the territory tab. Buy the 
second building of both the Foreign Influence and Governance Trade Company 
Investments. 

This is one of only two achievements which allows a custom nation on the 
map which can't be earned by playing that custom nation.

achievements.name: The Levant Turnabout
achievements.description: As the Mamluks, have 100 Army Professionalism and annex the Ottomans.
achievements.requirements:
- Have *100* Army Professionalism
- Ottomans does *not* exist
- Own and core Edirne (149), Constantinople (151), Hüdavendigar (317), 
and Ankara (326)
achievements.notes:
Be sure to attack the Ottomans early or at least cut them off from further 
expansion into Arabia and the Caucasus. You also don't need to have 100% 
professionalism at the time of annexing the Ottomans. You can just build up 
to that number later.

achievements.name: The Burgundian Conquest
achievements.description:
As Burgundy, own the Low Countries region as core provinces and have 
France and Austria as your subjects.
achievements.requirements:
- *Not* playing as a released vassal
- Is Burgundy*or*Lotharingia
- Has Austria and France as subjects
- Own and core all provinces in the Low Countries region.

achievements.name: Sweet Home Qaraqorum
achievements.description: As the Mughals assimilate Mongolian culture.
achievements.requirements:
- Is Mughals
- Has the Mughal Diwan government reform
- Have Mongol as accepted culture
achievements.notes:
Easiest by starting as the Timurids. Forming the Mughals should not be a 
problem as long as you keep your vassals loyal and conquer Delhi. After 
that you should carve your way up to the Mongolian culture area. Fabricate 
claims along the way and conquer the provinces needed to reach that area. 
Usually you can start by declaring war on Uzbek, followed by Oirat. The 
factions controlling those provinces differ from campaign to campaign. In 
order to assimilate you need to conquer ALL Mongolian culture provinces. 
With the Winds of Change DLC mission tree, staying as Timurids is advise to 
use their bonuses and permanent claim on the mongol region.

achievements.name: Mewar Never Changes
achievements.description: Complete the Mewar Mission Tree.
achievements.requirements: Has completed all Mewari missions
achievements.notes:
This achievement is only visible if the country has Mewari missions, but it 
is not required to start as Mewar. It is also possible to start as any non end-game 
tag and then form Rajputana to get these missions.

achievements.name: Ideas Guy
achievements.description:
Starting as a custom nation with the full 800 points but no more than 3 
total development, have a monthly income of at least 500 ducats.
achievements.startingConditions:
- Playing as a custom nation
- Only 1 custom nation exists in the world
- Used no more than 801 nation designer points
- No more than 3 total development
achievements.requirements:
- *Not* playing as a released vassal
- Has at least 500 ducats in income
achievements.notes:
Despite the description, can be done with fewer than 800 points. Spoils of 
war do not count towards the income; you must make 500 ducats, not 
including Spoils.
It became very easy after Third Rome, due to Siberian frontier ability: 
Start a nation in Americas with Siberian Frontier as a tradition, it will 
allow you to expand in uncolonized regions rapidly. 

Can also be paired with For Odin! and From Humble Origins

-

achievements.name: Bengal Tiger
achievements.description: Start as Bengal and own Samarkand as a core province.
achievements.requirements: Own and core Samarkand.

achievements.name: AEIOU
achievements.description: Complete the Austrian mission tree.
achievements.requirements:
- Complete one of the following mission trees: 
- Austrian missions from the Emperor DLC
- Austrian missions from the Winds of Change DLC
achievements.notes:
You can trigger the religious peace by enacting "Proclaim Erbkaisertum" 
reform, since it will not block the mission A Holy Empire. Forming another 
country which gives new missions (e.g. Germany or unifying the Holy Roman 
Empire) will prevent you from getting the achievement.

*or*

achievements.name: Maharana Pratap
achievements.description: Start as Mewar and field an army of 20 Rajput regiments.
achievements.requirements: Has at least 20 Rajput regiments
achievements.notes:
See Rajput regiment and Special unit force limit for ways to get more 
Rajput regiments. Forming another country such as Rajputana does not 
prevent the achievement, but the formed country will still need to have 
access to the Rajputs estate.

achievements.name: Kow-Tow
achievements.description: As Ming, have a subject from each religion group.
achievements.requirements:
- *Not* playing as a released vassal
- Have a subject nation in the 5 religious groups Christian, Muslim, 
Eastern, Dharmic and Pagan
achievements.notes:
- The Jewish and Zoroastrian groups are *not* needed.
- No CB War against Mikhlaf in Arabia, vassalize them in the peace deal. 
Ally a neighbour (Yemen or Hormuz can be a good choice), ask for maps of 
the horn of Africa and then establish one of the Coptic minors as a 
tributary or vassal. Medri Bahri can be a good choice. Proclaim a Guarantee 
to protect them while you improve relations.

achievements.name: The White Elephant
achievements.description: As Ayutthaya, own all of Indochina and Burma as core provinces.
achievements.requirements:
- *Not* playing as a released vassal
- Is Ayutthaya*or*Siam
- Own and core all of the Indochina and Burma regions

achievements.name: A Sun God
achievements.description:
Form Inca, embrace all Institutions and own all of South America as core 
provinces.
achievements.requirements:
- Is Inca
- *Not* playing as a released vassal
- Have embraced all institutions
- All provinces in South America are either empty, wasteland, a colony 
or owned and cored Inca.
achievements.notes:
The Falklands (1095), South Georgia (2025) and Galapagos (2002) are also 
part of South America. It is useful to colonize them before a strong 
colonizer can do it, because these provinces won't become part of a 
colonial nation. This achievement is very hard without El Dorado, but 
pretty easy without it.

achievements.name: Forever Golden
achievements.description: Complete the Spanish Mission Tree.
achievements.requirements:
- Complete one of the following mission trees: 
- Spanish missions from the Golden Century DLC.
- Castilian/Spanish missions from the Domination DLC.
- Aragonese missions from the Domination DLC*and* the lower half of 
the Castilian missions which Aragon gets upon forming Spain.
achievements.notes:
The achievement *cannot* be completed with the Aragonese missions from the 
Golden Century DLC. If the Golden Century, but not the Domination DLC is 
active, Spain must be formed by a country which does *not* have Aragonese 
*nor* Catalan as primary culture, because these cultures give Aragonese 
missions instead of Spanish missions(culture converting after formation 
does not change your missions).

- *or*

achievements.name: Take that, von Habsburgs!
achievements.description: Starting as Hungary, own all of Austria as core provinces.
achievements.requirements:
- *Not* playing as a released vassal
- Is Hungary*or*Austria-Hungary
- Own and core all of the Inner Austria, Austria Proper, Carniola and 
Tirol areas.
achievements.notes:
Besides provinces from Austria, also requires taking Istria (130) from 
Venice, Cilli (4751) from Cilli, Trentino (110) from Trent and Bregenz 
(4710) from Bregenz. Does not require Sundgau (1880), Breisgau (72) or 
anything else Austria may have expanded into.

achievements.name: Switzerlake
achievements.description: Own 99 provinces as Switzerland while owning no ports.
achievements.requirements:
- *Not* playing as a released vassal
- Own 99 provinces
- Own no ports
achievements.notes:
Can be achieved as part of a normal game and then giving away all the 
coastal provinces. Avoid expanding into the Holy Roman Empire to prevent 
high aggressive expansion.

achievements.name: Kirishitan Japan
achievements.description:
Start as a Japanese Daimyo, convert yourself and all of Japan to 
Christianity.
achievements.requirements:
- Is Japan
- In Christian religious group
- All provinces in Japanese region are in Christian religious group.
achievements.notes:
- You must start as a Daimyo subject of Ashikaga. The Japan region 
includes Okinawa, Hokkaido, and the Kuril Islands. Uncolonized provinces 
are required as well. Best done with Otomo, who receive an extra 
missionary in addition to increased papal influence.
- Wait for the Spread of Christianity incident, which usually pops up 
around 1600 or so. Always take the most "Open" or pro-Christian options in 
events. A few years after the incident ends, an event to convert to 
Catholic will pop up.
- If Mandate of Heaven is disabled: don't take the decision to enforce 
Sakoku, wait for events to convert your provinces and spawn Catholic 
rebels, and let them convert at least half your provinces. Harder if you 
have too many disconnected provinces outside the Japan region.

achievements.name: Back in Control
achievements.description: Form Yuan and be the only nation holding land in China.
achievements.requirements:
- Is Yuan
- All colonized provinces in the China super-region owned by Yuan.
achievements.notes: Taiwan is only required if it is colonized.

achievements.name: The Six Nations
achievements.description: Form a Federation of at least six nations as the Iroquois.
achievements.requirements:
- *Not* playing as a released vassal
- Primary culture is *Iroquois*
- Is leader of a federation with six nations in it
achievements.notes: Easily done as Onondaga by inviting a nation to your federation on day one.

achievements.name: Sweet Harmony
achievements.description: Harmonize 7 religions as Confucian.
achievements.requirements:
- Is Confucian
- Have 7 harmonized religions
achievements.notes:
Harmonization takes 33.3 years, but events can speed it up marginally. Ming 
and Korea start with Mahayana already harmonized. Easiest as Ming, 
conquering some Hindu, Sunni, and Shinto land. 

It is also a good option to start as Korea, form Japan, then conquer 
Philippines, Indonesia to achieve this achievement. Harmonization requires 
owning 20 development of the target religion or religious group. Might be 
quicker and more fun to create a custom nation with harmonizing ideas.

- 
-

achievements.name: Pirate Bay of Janjira
achievements.description: Have more than 50% Privateering power in the Gujarat trade node
achievements.requirements: - Has at least 50% trade power from privateers in the Gujarat trade node
achievements.notes:
One of 

- 
- 
- 
-

achievements.name: Made in Japan
achievements.description: Embrace "manufactories" institution as Japan by 1655.
achievements.requirements:
- The year is before 1655
- Is Japan
- Has embraced the Manufactories institution
achievements.notes:
Colonize the west coast of America as soon as possible to gain Colonialism. 
Do not enforce Sakoku when the option presents itself, since that will make 
it harder to get Global Trade.

achievements.name: Holiest Roman Empire
achievements.description:
As either the Papal States or the Emperor, have the Papal States as an 
Elector while the HRE is officially Catholic.
achievements.requirements:
- Is The Papal State*or* is the emperor of the Holy Roman Empire
- Catholic is the dominant faith of the Holy Roman Empire
- The Holy Roman Empire has an official, unchangeable faith
- The Papal State is an elector
achievements.notes:
You can start as Austria, and full annex The Papal State. When The Papal 
State is given a province in the empire, you can grant them elector status. 

Note that passing the Proclaim Erbkaisertum reform before Catholicism is 
the official faith of the HRE will enact the Peace of Westphalia, 
preventing this achievement.

achievements.name: Baa Baa Black Sheep
achievements.description: As Qara Qoyunlu become the leading producer of wool.
achievements.requirements: Be production leader of wool
achievements.notes:
You start with 5 wool-producing provinces. Focus solely on accumulating 
diplomatic points to develop them. Can be done before 1450. 

Alternatively, annexing Bitlis with 3 additional provinces will reduce the 
amount of developing needed (note that annexation can start as early as 
1445 in this case). Annexing neighbouring OPM Hisn Kayfa also helps, as 
they produce wool.

achievements.name: The Re-Reconquista
achievements.description: As Granada, form Andalusia and reconquer all of Iberia.
achievements.requirements:
- Is Andalusia
- Own and core all provinces of Iberia
achievements.notes:
Optimal strategy is to start expanding to north Africa by picking weak 
targets like Tlemcen and Tunis. After the initial expansions, secure an 
alliance with either Ottomans or Mamluks as soon as possible. Colonizing 
North America early can boost your income and drastically weaken the 
economy of Spain.

achievements.name: King of Jerusalem
achievements.description: Form the Kingdom of Jerusalem as Cyprus or The Knights.
achievements.requirements: Is Jerusalem
achievements.notes:
Completing the mission Jerusalem! allows forming Jerusalem after the age of 
reformation.

achievements.name: I'll graze my horse here.. And here...
achievements.description: As a Horde, own over 200 provinces producing grain.
achievements.requirements:
- Has Steppe Nomad or Great Mongol State reform
- 200 provinces produce grain *or* livestock

achievements.name: Anglophile
achievements.description: Complete all English and British missions.
achievements.startingConditions:
- *Not* using a random New World
- Has a culture out of the British group.
achievements.requirements:
- Complete one of the following mission trees: 
- British missions from the Rule Britannia DLC.
- English/British missions from the Domination DLC.
- Angevin missions from the Domination DLC.
achievements.notes:
- Strategies for Rule Britannia missions: 
- Provided you are able to force France into a PU, the missions are 
fairly easy to complete apart from being elected Emperor of the HRE - you 
will either need to convert to Protestant and win the league wars, or 
convert to Anglican or Reformed and hope the Peace of Westphalia occurs - 
which can be very difficult. You may want to stay out of the league wars 
and rent out your troops to the losing side so you can keep the war going.
- Alternatively, you can just disband the HRE while remaining any 
religion.

- *or*

achievements.name: The Navigator
achievements.description: As Portugal, own provinces in Africa, India and Indonesia before 1500.
achievements.requirements:
- The year is before 1500
- Owns a province in the continent of Africa and the super-regions of 
India and East Indies.
achievements.notes:
It's enough to just start a colony. It doesn't need to be finished. 
Portugal gets an event to instantly annex Goa if the appropriate mission is 
completed. The islands of Hollhavai and the Maldives are considered part of 
the East Indies despite being closer to India.

achievements.name: The Iron Price
achievements.description: Restore the Danelaw region to Danish rule, and make it Danish culture.
achievements.requirements:
- Own and core Northumberland and the Yorkshire, East Midlands, and East 
Anglia areas.
- All these provinces have *Danish*culture.

achievements.name: Krabater
achievements.description: Form the nation of Croatia and station a unit of cavalry in Stockholm.
achievements.requirements:
- *Not* playing as a released vassal
- Is Croatia
- Station a unit of cavalry in Stockholm.
achievements.notes:
Croatia doesn't actually have to be formed for the achievement. All you 
have to do to get this achievement is to start as Croatia, ask for military 
access from Sweden, load your starting cavalry regiment onto a transport, 
then sail up next to Stockholm and move your cavalry onto it.

achievements.name: Hard Bargaining
achievements.description:
As Defender of a Muslim Faith, propagate your religion in The Moluccas 
through trade to convert 5 provinces.
achievements.requirements:
- Is in the Muslim religious group
- Is Defender of the Faith
- Propagated Religion in 5 provinces in the Moluccas trade node
achievements.notes:
You are required to be Defender of the Faith when the conversion of each 
province finishes.

- 
-

achievements.name: This is Persia!
achievements.description:
Form Persia or Eranshahr, and own Egypt, Anatolia and Greece as core 
provinces.
achievements.requirements:
- *Not* playing as a released vassal
- Is Persia*or*Eranshahr
- All provinces in the regions Anatolia and Egypt and the areas Morea, Northern 
Greece, and Macedonia are owned and cored by Persia*or*Eranshahr.
achievements.notes:
Persia can be formed by a nation whose primary culture is in the Iranian 
culture group, or by Aq Qoyunlu and Qara Qoyunlu . 

Before patch 1.36.2, this achievement was only possible as Persia and not 
as Eranshahr.

achievements.name: Prester John
achievements.description:
Starting as Ethiopia, own and have cores on Alexandria, Antioch and 
Constantinople as a Coptic country.
achievements.requirements:
- Is Coptic
- Own and core Alexandria, Antioch and Constantinople.
achievements.notes:
The most challenging part is timing the war with the Mamluks so that they 
are beatable but haven't lost too much land to the Ottomans. Once you have 
a border on the Mediterranean, steal or trade for maps to see and ally 
European majors for fighting the Turks.

achievements.name: Baltic Crusader
achievements.description:
As Teutonic Order or Livonian Order, own all of Russia as core provinces 
and convert it to Catholic.
achievements.startingConditions:
Playing as *either*: 

- Livonian Order
- Teutonic Order
achievements.requirements:
- *Not* playing as a released vassal
- Is Livonian Order or Teutonic Order
- Own and core all fully colonized provinces in the Pontic Steppe, Russia, 
and Ural regions.
- All these provinces are Catholic
achievements.notes:
Easiest as Teutonic Order; ally Muscovy, Austria and Bohemia and DOW Poland 
ASAP, or else Poland will form a PU with Lithuania. Restarting until Poland 
declines the PU is also a viable strategy.

achievements.name: Spice Girls
achievements.description:
Having a female ruler, have active trading bonuses for Cloves, Spices, 
Salt and Sugar.
achievements.requirements:
- Have a female ruler
- Has country modifier *Trading in Cloves*
- Has country modifier *Trading in Spices*
- Has country modifier *Trading in Salt*
- Has country modifier *Trading in Sugar*
achievements.notes:
- This achievement is only visible if the Leviathan DLC is active, but 
it can be achieved even without the DLC.
- Having a Queen Regency with a male heir is sufficient.

achievements.name: Sinaasappel!
achievements.description:
Get Orangists in power with 100% Republican Tradition, and owning a 
province in China.
achievements.requirements:
- *Not* playing as a released vassal
- Orangists/Monarchists are in power
- *99%* Republican tradition
- Own and core at least one province in the China sub-continent.
achievements.notes:
- Orangist-Statist mechanics require the Dutch Republic (only available 
for countries with Dutch, Frisian or Flemish culture) or The Feuillant 
System (only available to Revolutionary republics). It is *not* possible 
to get the achievement with the various monarchy and theocracy reforms 
which have this mechanic(Stadhouder Monarchy, States General, Ganden 
Phodrang, Dutch Archbishopric, Open Public Elections), because they 
can't get republican tradition.
- The achievement will not be visible unless the country's primary 
culture is Dutch or Flemish, but it can still be obtained.
- Colonizing Taiwan counts for the achievement; no need to wait for a 
Mingplosion.

achievements.name: Redecorating
achievements.description: Starting as an Orthodox Nation, Consecrate Metropolitan in Roma.
achievements.requirements:
- Own and core Roma
- Activated *consecrate metropolitan* in the stated area of 
*Lazio-Umbria*
achievements.notes:
Orthodox nations in 1444: Beloozero, Byzantium, Circassia, Georgia, 
Herzegovina, Moldavia, Muscovy, Novgorod, Odoyev, Perm, Pskov, Rostov, 
Ryazan, Samtskhe, Serbia, Theodoro, Trebizond, Tver, Wallachia, and 
Yaroslavl

Easiest to do as Muscovy.

achievements.name: Consulate of the Sea
achievements.description: As Aragon conquer all Mediterranean Centers of Trade.
achievements.requirements: Own the following provinces:
achievements.notes:
*For the event see: Consulate of the Sea.*

The requirements do not match the actual Centers of Trade.

achievements.name: Luck of the Irish
achievements.description: Own and have cores on the British Isles as an Irish nation.
achievements.requirements: Own and core all provinces of the Britain region.
achievements.notes:
Possible starts are Clanricarde, Desmond, Kildare, Leinster, Munster, Offaly, 
Ormond, Sligo, Thomond, Tyrconnell, Tyrone and Ulster. 

Desmond is a good choice due to early military ideas. Rushing to conquer 
the rest of the Irish OPMs and securing an alliance with Scotland can deter 
England until the time is right.

achievements.name: Gold Rush
achievements.description: Reform the Golden Horde before 1500.
achievements.startingConditions:
- Government type is *Steppe Nomads*
- Culture group is *Tatar*
achievements.requirements:
- The year is before 1500
- Is Golden Horde

achievements.name: Big Blue Blob
achievements.description: As France, hold 100 European core provinces before 1500.
achievements.requirements:
- *Not* playing as a released vassal
- Is France
- Own and core 100 provinces in Europe
- The year is before 1500
achievements.notes:
Most used route is attacking Scandinavia or Balkans. Make sure to conquer 
low-development provinces to limit AE.

achievements.name: Turning the Tide
achievements.description: Start as a Steppe Horde in 1444 and embrace all institutions.
achievements.requirements:
- *Not* playing as a released vassal
- Have embraced all institutions
achievements.notes:
Much faster in pre-1.17 patches, where the requirement is westernizing, 
which can be done by around 1520 instead of waiting until 1750 for the 
institutions to appear.

achievements.name: World Conqueror
achievements.description: Own or have a subject own the entire world.
achievements.requirements:
The only existing countries are the player's country and its direct 
non-tributary subjects and their non-tributary subjects.
achievements.notes:
- Subjects of subjects count as long as they are not tributaries (e.g., 
Colonies of a client state or Vassals of a personal union). But colonial 
nations of a vassal of a junior partner don't count, because they are 
subjects of a subject of a subject.

achievements.name: Qing of China
achievements.description: Become Chinese Emperor as Qing and own all of China.
achievements.requirements:
- Is Qing
- Is Emperor of China
- Own all provinces in the China super region.

achievements.name: Better than Napoleon
achievements.description: As France, own Vienna, Berlin and Moscow as core provinces.
achievements.requirements:
- *Not* playing as a released vassal
- Is France
- Own and core Moskva, Berlin, and Wien.

achievements.name: A Blessed Nation
achievements.description: As a Coptic Nation, gain all 5 Blessings.
achievements.requirements:
- Is Coptic
- Have 5 active blessings
achievements.notes:
Player can start as Muslim nation (such as The Ottomans) and switch 
religion by rebels.

achievements.name: Voltaire's Nightmare
achievements.description: Have at least 100 countries in the HRE.
achievements.startingConditions:
- No more than 1 custom nation exists in the world
- Used no more than 201 nation designer points if playing as a custom 
nation
achievements.requirements: At least 100 countries are members of the Holy Roman Empire
achievements.notes:
Create a custom nation with your capital in the HRE (you could go for 
Triest) and give yourself provinces with releasable tags within and 
adjacent to the empire. Add all provinces to the empire and release all 
tags to instantly unlock the achievement. 

Possible provinces are Dauphiné, Narbonnais, Rouergue, Auvergne, Castellón, 
Mallorca, Girona, Sasser, Corsica, Parma, Modena, Spoleto, Perugia, Bari, 
Friuli, Padova, Spalato, Corfu, Arta, Atene, Nasso, Rhodes, Creta, Sugla, 
Lienz, Unterkärnten, Hradiste, Ruppin, Rügen, Trencsén and Dolní Lužice.

achievements.name: Even Better than Piet Heyn
achievements.description: Gain over 100 gold from privateering a single treasure fleet.
achievements.requirements: Gained over 100 gold by plundering a treasure fleet.

achievements.name: My True Friend
achievements.description: Go to war in support of a rebel faction and win, enforcing their demands.
achievements.requirements: Help a rebel faction win a war against another country
achievements.notes: Can be completed at the same time as the Viva la Revolución! achievement.

achievements.name: Lion of the North
achievements.description:
Start as Sweden and lead the Protestant League to victory against the 
Emperor.
achievements.requirements:
- Is Protestant
- Lead and win League War
achievements.notes: Has to be Protestant and lead the League.

achievements.name: That's a Silk Road
achievements.description: Own or have a subject own all provinces in the world producing silk.
achievements.requirements:
All provinces with silk are owned by the player's country or its 
non-tributary subjects.
achievements.notes:
Silk provinces stretch from Granada to Kyoto, with concentrations in the 
Persia, India and South China regions. With Golden Century, Aragon has a 
mission that makes Valencia produce silk. With Emperor, Milan has a mission 
that makes Como produce silk.

achievements.name: Laughingstock
achievements.description: Own the provinces of Haha, Hehe and Lolland.
achievements.requirements: Own the provinces of Lolland (1983), Haha (2470), and Hehe (4073)
achievements.notes:
Lolland begins held by Denmark, Haha held by Morocco, and Hehe uncolonized 
in Central Africa. 

Easiest to No CB Morocco before Iberians take Haha, then push through Kongo 
with expansion ideas to reach Hehe which must be colonized. Can also be 
paired with African Power.

achievements.name: Shahanshah
achievements.description: Start as Ardabil and form Persia or Eranshahr.
achievements.requirements:
- *Not* playing as a released vassal
- Is Persia*or*Eranshahr
achievements.notes:
It's possible to get Bahmanis in India as an ally by improving relations 
until you can royal marry them (which removes their "Unknown") relations 
modifier. This will deter nearby attackers as you expand opportunistically.

achievements.name: Guarantor of Peace
achievements.description: Guarantee the Independence of France, The Ottoman Empire and Russia.
achievements.requirements:
- Guarantee the independence of: 
- France
- Ottomans
- Russia
achievements.notes:
You can only guarantee a country if you are larger than it. Can be achieved 
easily after unifying the HRE.

achievements.name: Spain is the Emperor
achievements.description: Become the Emperor of the Holy Roman Empire as Spain.
achievements.startingConditions: Not the emperor of the Holy Roman Empire
achievements.requirements:
- Is Spain
- Is the emperor of the Holy Roman Empire
achievements.notes:
Easiest to do as Aragon by allying Austria in 1444, abandoning your 
Personal Union with Naples, and returning 1-2 provinces in Sicily to get 
just below 200 development. This way, you can add your provinces to the HRE 
so becoming the Emperor is much easier. Once you get to Administrative 
Technology 10, and the Iberian Wedding event has happened, form Spain 
diplomatically. Wait until you're already Emperor or you'll have to leave 
the HRE and it will become much harder to do again.

achievements.name: Relentless Push East
achievements.description: Starting as a Russian nation, By 1600 own the East Siberian Coastline.
achievements.requirements:
- Year is before 1601
- Own all port provinces in the *East Siberia* region

These provinces are Kamchatka, Penzhina, Kagyrgyn, Gizhiga, Tauisk, Okhotsk 
and Jugjur.
achievements.notes:
- Note that it is not necessary to core the provinces. Even unfinished 
colonies count.
- This achievement is pretty easy to reach as Muscovy and you can finish 
it 40 to 50 years before the deadline. It is recommended to form Russia 
and take advantage of their Siberian Frontier idea, helping idea groups 
like exploration and expansion will then be optional. But a colonist from 
these groups can be used to start colonies if the time runs out and one of 
the Siberian ports has already been cored or fully colonized.

achievements.name: Kingdom of God
achievements.description: Starting as the Papal State, become the Kingdom of God
achievements.startingConditions:
- Playing as The Papal State
- *Not* using a random New World
achievements.requirements: Has enacted the decision Declare the Kingdom of God

achievements.name: Dar al-Islam
achievements.description: Unify Islam under your rule.
achievements.requirements:
- Is in the Muslim religious group.
- Has country modifier *A United Islam*

Enact the "Unify Islam" decision. Requires the following provinces:
achievements.notes:
- Requires Star and Crescent DLC.
- Easiest to do as Ottomans.

achievements.name: Poland can into space
achievements.description: As Poland, reach the maximum level in all technologies (32).
achievements.requirements:
- Administrative technology is *32*
- Diplomatic technology is *32*
- Military technology is *32*

achievements.name: Foul Mouthed
achievements.description: Scornfully insult 10 nations that border you.
achievements.startingConditions:
- No more than 1 custom nation exists in the world
- Used no more than 201 nation designer points
achievements.requirements:
- At least 10 neighbouring countries have the *“Scornfully Insulted”* 
opinion modifier towards you
achievements.notes:
The 10 countries must all have the opinion modifier at the same time. 
Lithuania borders 11 nations at the start of game. Very easy in 1.32. Keep 
giving the burgers the Patronage of the Arts privilege then revoke it and 
give it again. Giving it three times puts you over 50 prestige. Then 
scornfully insult 10 of Lithuania's 11 neighbours.

- 
-

achievements.name: God Tier
achievements.description:
Become a Tier 5 Defender of the Faith as a nation that is neither Catholic 
nor Sunni.
achievements.requirements:
- Religion is *not* Catholic or Sunni
- Is defender of the faith of tier 5
achievements.notes:
Easiest to do as a HRE member state such as Holland. Convert to 
Protestantism as soon as possible. The amount of HRE minors who will 
convert should minimise the amount of player involvement. If necessary, 
declare war on smaller European nations and use the "Force Religion" option 
in the peace deal. Colonial nations also contribute to the rank of Defender 
of the Faith. 

The achievement is hidden without the Emperor DLC, but it is possible to 
get the achievement without the DLC, by having 50+ nations following the 
faith you are defender of.

achievements.name: Czechs and Balances
achievements.description:
Starting as Bohemia, grant at least two privileges to each estate while 
having at least 50% Crown Land.
achievements.startingConditions:
- Playing as Bohemia
- *Not* using a random New World
achievements.requirements:
- At least two privileges are granted to the Clergy
- At least two privileges are granted to the Burghers
- At least two privileges are granted to the Nobility
- Land owned by the crown is at least 50%
achievements.notes:
This can be done easily by starting as Bohemia and then releasing Moravia 
as a vassal and selecting the option to play as the released vassal. 
Afterwards, you'll have more than 80% Crown Land and now you can give 2 
privileges to each estate. Several of the privileges do not affect the size 
of the Crown Land which makes it easy to stay above 50.

achievements.name: Arabian Coffee
achievements.description: Form Arabia and be the nation producing the most coffee in the world.
achievements.requirements:
- *Not* playing as a released vassal
- Is Arabia
- Be production leader of coffee
achievements.notes:
Coffee is common in the area around Ethiopia and Mali. If you are not the 
leading producer after conquering these areas, build manufactories or 
conquer Mesoamerica. Forming Arabia is easiest as The Mamluks.

achievements.name: Networking
achievements.description: Have 100 point spy networks in 3 Rival nations.
achievements.requirements: Have 100 point spy networks in 3 rival nations
achievements.notes:
Hard to get with Mare Nostrum enabled since AI will use counter-espionage 
against rivals. 

A slow but easy method involves starting as a nation with at least 3 
diplomats, building the spy networks in your rival nations and waiting 
until you get the achievement or annexed.

achievements.name: An Industrial Evolution
achievements.description:
As Great Britain, own all of England as core provinces and have at least 
25 development in each province there.
achievements.requirements:
- *Not* as a released vassal.
- Is Great Britain
- Own and have cores on the London, East Midlands, West Midlands, East 
Anglia, Wessex, and Yorkshire areas with each province having at least 25 
development. (The Northern England area is not needed.)

achievements.name: Georgia on my Mind
achievements.description: Fully own all three Georgias.
achievements.requirements:
Own or have a non-tributary subject own all provinces in the areas: 
Kartli-Kakheti, Samtskhe and Imereti. 

- Own or have a non-tributary subject own all provinces in the areas: 
Georgia and Upper Georgia
- Own or have a non-tributary subject own the province of South Georgia 
(2025)
achievements.notes:
Easiest to do as a coloniser such as France, Spain or Great Britain since 
you can easily acquire the required provinces in North America and the 
South Atlantic. Remaining provinces can be obtained by declaring no-CB wars 
on nations in Caucasia to vassalize them early before they're conquered by 
Russia or the Ottomans.

achievements.name: Nobody wants to die
achievements.description: Own Timbuktu as Songhai
achievements.requirements: Own and core the province of Timbuktu
achievements.notes:
Can be done swiftly by declaring a no-casus belli war a month from the 
start of the game, before any alliances are made. Hiring a handful of 
mercenaries will help with the conquest, whereas hiring an administrative 
advisor and changing the national focus to administrative will help to core 
the province sooner.

achievements.name: Master of India
achievements.description: Own and have cores on all of India as a European nation.
achievements.requirements:
Own or have a non-tributary subject own all provinces in the Indian 
sub-continent (regions Deccan, Coromandel, Bengal, Hindustan and Western 
India).
achievements.notes:
It's *not* required anymore for the player to directly own all provinces 
inside the Indian sub-continent. Vassals and other direct subjects count as 
long as they are not tributaries. Coring the provinces is also no longer 
required. 

The capital does not need to remain in Europe. Edirne is European, so the 
Ottomans are eligible and have the best shot at a quick land rush into 
India.

achievements.name: Fanatic Collectivist
achievements.description: Own all Institution Origin provinces.
achievements.requirements:
- Own the institution origin provinces for 
- Renaissance
- Colonialism
- Printing Press
- Global Trade
- Manufactories
- Enlightenment
- Industrialization

achievements.name: Sweden is not overpowered!
achievements.description: Own and have cores on the entire Baltic coastline as Sweden.
achievements.requirements: Own and core the following provinces:

achievements.name: Trade Hegemon
achievements.description:
Starting as any European country, conquer and have cores on Aden, Hormoz 
and Malacca.
achievements.requirements: Own and core the provinces of Aden, Hormuz and Malacca
achievements.notes:
Note that nations such as Ottomans, Kazan and Great Horde are considered as 
European countries.

achievements.name: The Power of Three
achievements.description: Own a Crown Colony, a Self-Governing Colony and a Private Enterprise.
achievements.requirements:
- Has a Crown Colony
- Has a Self-Governing Colony
- Has a Private Enterprise

achievements.name: The Rising Sun
achievements.description: Own and have cores on all of Japan as a European nation.
achievements.requirements: Own and core all provinces in the Japan region
achievements.notes:
- The Japan region includes Okinawa, Tsushima, Hokkaido, and the Kuril 
Islands.
- One possible and relatively easy way to do this is with Spain. After 
you can reach the East Siberian Coastline after getting some colonies in 
North or South America, get a colony there and start wars with Japan 
afterwards. Due to their lacking of good military forces and technology 
those wars are pretty easy to win.

achievements.name: Definitely the Sultan of Rum
achievements.description: Own and have cores on Rome, Moscow and Istanbul as Ottomans or Rum.
achievements.requirements:
- Is Ottomans or Rûm
- Own and core Moskva, Constantinople, and Roma.
achievements.notes: Make sure to attack Muscovy ASAP to remove a future potential threat.

achievements.name: Subsidize my Love
achievements.description:
Subsidize 3 different allies at least 50% of their monthly income without 
running a deficit.
achievements.requirements:
- Does not have negative monthly income
- Have 3 allies that are subsidized at least 50%.
achievements.notes:
The subsidies also count as income, so the subsidies have to be as high as 
the total income before the subsidies. The total income can be seen in the 
Income Comparison page in the ledger. The Country page doesn't show all 
income sources. 

Easily done as England with the Irish minors or as Austria with HRE OPMs.

achievements.name: Over a Thousand!
achievements.description: Own 1001 provinces directly.
achievements.requirements: Own 1001 provinces
achievements.notes:
Colonial provinces taken in war from other nations do not add 
overextension. Colonial nations won't be established as long as less than 5 
provinces are cored so don't core them until you get the achievement.

achievements.name: Winged Hussars
achievements.description:
Have Winged Hussars as your active unit with more than +50% cavalry combat 
ability.
achievements.requirements:
- Have Winged Hussars as your primary cavalry unit
- Have a cavalry combat ability of at least 50%
achievements.notes:
- Winged Hussars cavalry unit is part of the Eastern technology group 
(military tech level 22). For details on cavalry combat ability see the 
article on Land units.
- Poland is the easiest nation to play for this achievement due to the 
cavalry combat ability in their national ideas. Taking Aristocratic and 
Quality ideas will give Poland enough combat ability to satisfy this 
achievement.

achievements.name: One King to Rule!
achievements.description: As Poland, become an absolutist monarchy, abolishing the Sejm.
achievements.requirements:
- *Not* playing as a released vassal
- Is a monarchy
- Have 50 absolutism
- Has *not* enacted one of the following government reforms: 
- ‘Elective Monarchy’
- ‘Great Sejm’
- ‘Polish Elective Monarchy’

achievements.name: Mare Nostrum
achievements.description:
Restore the Roman Empire and own the entire Mediterranean and Black Sea 
coast lines.
achievements.startingConditions: Not playing as The Papal State
achievements.requirements:
- Is Roman Empire
- Own the following provinces:
achievements.notes:
Easiest to do as the Ottomans after converting to Christianity. 
Alternatively, with Golden Century, this is relatively easy as Aragon as 
their mission tree gives you claims on most of the required territory. With , 
Byzantium has a tough start but very strong ideas and missions that give 
claims on almost all required land.

achievements.name: The Spice Must Flow
achievements.description: Form the nation of Malaya.
achievements.requirements:
- *Not* playing as a released vassal
- Is Malaya
achievements.notes: Easiest as Malacca or Pasai.

achievements.name: A tale of two Families
achievements.description:
Starting as Vijayanagar or Bahmanis conquer the other’s capital and have 
them not exist.
achievements.requirements:
- Own and core the provinces Bidar (1948) and Vijayanagar (541)
- Is *either*: 
- Bahmanis and Vijayanagar doesn't exist
- Vijayanagar and Bahmanis doesn't exist

achievements.name: Colonial Management
achievements.description:
Have 3 colonial governors that were directly appointed by you at the same 
time.
achievements.requirements:
Appoint 3 colonial governors holding office in your colonies at the same 
time
achievements.notes:
*“Replace Governor”* is a subject action you may perform on your crown 
colonies.

achievements.name: The Grand Armada
achievements.description: Have 500 heavy ships and no loans.
achievements.requirements:
- Have 500 heavy ships
- Have no loans
achievements.notes:
Best done with a high income nation with naval force limit and ship build 
cost bonuses. Netherlands, Venice, and Genoa are optimal but can easily be 
done with England, Spain or Malaya. This can be done much more easily by 
debasing currency.

achievements.name: A Manchurian Candidate
achievements.description: Start as one of the Jurchen tribes and form Qing.
achievements.requirements: Is Qing
achievements.notes: You need to form Manchu first to be able to form Qing.

achievements.name: Liberty or Death
achievements.description: Start as USA in 1776 bookmark and own all your cores while being at peace.
achievements.startingConditions:
- Start on *4 July 1776*
- Playing as United States
- *Not* using a random New World.
achievements.requirements:
- Not at war
- United States: Owns all core provinces
achievements.notes:
Can be done easily by signing a peace treaty and accepting any demands. 
Then revoke all the cores of the provinces given away.

achievements.name: This Revolution Was Crushed
achievements.description:
In a war against the target of the Revolution, control their capital and 
have at least 99% war score.
achievements.requirements:
- Is at war with a revolution target
- Control the capital of the revolution target
- Have greater than *98%* warscore against the revolution target
achievements.notes:
The Revolution disaster (and the French Revolution variant) is announced in 
a major event: 'Revolution in $COUNTRY$' (or 'The General Estates'). 

With the Emperor DLC, there can be multiple revolutionary countries, but 
there can only be one revolutionary target. And it is possible that there 
is no revolutionary target even though there are revolutionary countries. 
The "Birthplace of the revolution" icon in the lower right part of the 
screen shows which country is the revolutionary target. 

Without the Emperor DLC, A country will become the revolution target, with 
"Revolutionary" in its name, if its capital is occupied by rebels while the 
disaster is active. The disaster spawns a stack of rebels, adds +10 
national unrest and removes 3 stability. The player can check if the 
disaster is still active for a country by looking for the +10 unrest 
modifier on its provinces. 

It is feasible both to wait for (or encourage) an AI revolution target, or 
to become the revolutionary target oneself before releasing (and playing 
as) a powerful vassal or colonial nation.

achievements.name: Not just Pizza
achievements.description: Become a Great Power as Naples.
achievements.requirements: Is a Great power

achievements.name: Black Jack
achievements.description:
Have at least 21 different subjects with 5 cities each and without any 
subject having 50% or more Liberty Desire. Trade Companies do not count.
achievements.requirements:
Has 21 different subjects with more than 5 cities and less than 50% liberty 
desire
achievements.notes:
Can be easily achieved with Tributary states as the Chinese Emperor with 
the Mandate of Heaven DLC or Ashikaga with its daimyos. 

Can also be achieved by conquering swathes of low-development land and 
releasing client states.

achievements.name: Narcissism
achievements.description: Corrupt the officials in a Rival country.
achievements.requirements:
Either 

- An army is led by a general with the player's Steam name
- Win a battle with a general with the player's Steam name

or 

- Has a leader named after one of the following VIPs - “DDRJake”, 
“Duplo”, “neondt”, “StarNaN”, “The French Paradox”, “Bus”, “Groogy”, 
“mikesc”, “PDJR_Alastorn”, “Ofaloaf”, “Caligula Caesar”, “Imse”, 
“KaiserJohan”, “Hawky”, “Johan”, “Pavía”, “Aldaron”, “SaintDaveUK”, 
“Gnivom”, “Big Boss”, “Comrade Flan”, “CzerstfyChlep”, “Pintu” or 
“Rossarness”
achievements.notes:
Is only visible with the Cradle of Civilization, but can be completed 
without that DLC by editing the player's Steam name to match the name of a 
general. Or by creating a custom nation with a monarch with the exact name 
as the player's Steam name and make him a general and win a battle with 
him. Or by using “Caligula” as the first name and “Caesar” as the dynasty 
of a ruler in a custom nation (or one of the other two word names).

-

achievements.name: You Get A New Home, And You Get A New Home
achievements.description: Expel 5 different minorities to your colonies.
achievements.startingConditions:
- No more than 1 custom nation exists in the world
- Used no more than 201 nation designer points if playing as a custom 
nation
achievements.requirements: Has expelled 5 different minorities to colonial provinces.

achievements.name: The Coin is Stronger than the Sword
achievements.description: Charter Company from an Indian nation.
achievements.startingConditions:
- No more than 1 custom nation exists in the world
- Used no more than 201 nation designer points
achievements.requirements:
Has successfully used the Charter Trade Company diplomatic interaction to 
buy a province in India.
achievements.notes:
Chartering a province from outside India proper will *not* grant the 
achievement (e.g. buying the Maldives from Vijayanagar), but chartering a 
province in India from a country which has it's capital somewhere else 
works.

-

achievements.name: Pyramid of Skulls
achievements.description: As a Steppe Horde, raze a province with at least 30 development.
achievements.requirements:
- Is steppe nomad
- Razed a province of at least 30 development.
achievements.notes:
The eligible provinces in 1444 are Nanjing (33), Beijing (31) and 
Constantinople after Ottoman conquest (34), although it is much easier to 
conquer a good province from a minor, develop it to 30, give it back, 
conquer again and finally raze it. The easiest way is to start as Uzbek, 
increase development in Qaraqalpak (440), release Khiva as vassal (one 
province), declare war and conquer the province. This can even be done 
without a war by giving a 30 dev province to a vassal an then seizing it. 
Uzbek can use Kypshak (476) for this, because it starts with 18 dev and 
then give it to Sibir, because they are easy to keep loyal.

achievements.name: Die Please Die
achievements.description:
Have a ruler with 1 or lower in all three categories who is over the age 
of 70.
achievements.requirements:
- Is *not* in a regency
- Have a ruler that: 
- Has less than *2* in every Monarch power
- Has reached the age of 70 years
achievements.notes:
Mali's and Kanem Bornu's rulers are eligible. Very easy in 1.22 or earlier 
with Timurids' 67 year old ruler. Karaman starts out with 1/0/0 leader and 
0/0/1 heir that can also work.

achievements.name: Basileus
achievements.description:
As Byzantium, restore the borders of the Eastern Roman Empire in the 
Balkans and Anatolia.
achievements.requirements:
- is Byzantium*or* the Roman Empire
- has never formed the Latin Empire[1]
- Own and core the following provinces:

achievements.name: We bled for this
achievements.description: Win a war with at least one million dead on both sides.
achievements.requirements: Won a war with over 1 million casualties on both sides.
achievements.notes:
- Both sides each need to have at least 1 million casualties (attrition 
*does* count) in the war details screen when the war leader is peaced 
out. Allies and enemies that are peaced out before the war leader do not 
contribute their casualties.
- League Wars can be a good time to get this achievement if you are the 
war leader. Protect your allies and don't separate peace countries. 
Alternatively, you can trigger a big war in the late 1700s after you get 
strong. Regardless, be prepared to buy down war exhaustion as the war will 
almost certainly last way longer than it should.

achievements.name: Cowardly Tactics
achievements.description:
Have a fort and a supply depot in a mountainous province producing 
livestock.
achievements.requirements:
Own and control a livestock-producing mountain province with a fort 
building and a supply depot
achievements.notes:
Easily done as Mamluks or the Three Leagues, who start with a fort on a 
livestock producing mountain province and 10% army professionalism.

- 
-

achievements.name: Marshy March
achievements.description: Have a march with at least two marsh provinces.
achievements.requirements: Have a march with at least two marsh provinces
achievements.notes: Easily done as Mushasha, simply release Basra and make them a march.

achievements.name: Imperio español
achievements.description: As Spain have Mexico, Panama, Havana, Cuzco in colonial Nations under you.
achievements.requirements:
- *Not* playing as a released vassal
- Is Spain
- Have colonial nations in Mexico, Panama, Havana, and Cuzco.

achievements.name: Wonderful
achievements.description: Own 8 different monuments on tier 3.
achievements.requirements: - Has 8 Tier 3 monuments
achievements.notes:
Easiest done with France as they starts with 2 and can expand into England, 
Iberia, Morocco and Norway while starting with a decent economy. 
Alternatively a Buddhist nation in Indochina can do it easily as they have 
6 eligible monuments in Tibet and Indochina alone and limited aggressive 
expansion penalties. 

India is also a good option as it has more than 8 monuments. If the 
monument has religious requirements preventing from building it, don't 
forget that you can improve your subject's monument and then integrate 
them.

achievements.name: Viva la Revolución!
achievements.description: Have rebels you support in another country enforce their demands.
achievements.requirements: Have supported rebels in another country that enforced their demands.
achievements.notes:
Possible to do as Tondo, as neighbouring Pangasinan starts with a single 
province of a heathen religion. Immediately rival them and declare an 
offensive war using the Humiliate Rival CB. Sit on their capital to 
increase their war exhaustion until you can support the Animist rebels. 
When an uprising is about to take place, white peace. The rebels will 
enforce their demands as soon as they take the province.

achievements.name: Industrial Powerhouse
achievements.description: Have 10 furnaces built in your nation.
achievements.startingConditions:
- No more than 1 custom nation exists in the world
- Used no more than 201 nation designer points if playing as a custom 
nation
achievements.requirements: - Have 10 furnaces

achievements.name: Just Resting In My Account
achievements.description: Corrupt the officials in a Rival country.
achievements.requirements: Used the covert action Corrupt Officials against a rival country.

achievements.name: Traditional Player
achievements.description: More than 90 percent Naval and Army Tradition.
achievements.requirements:
- Have *90*army tradition
- Have *90*navy tradition
achievements.notes:
Easiest to do with Utsunomiya as they get *-1%* decay to each respectively 
from their traditions and ideas. See the page Military tradition for other 
ways of gaining tradition.

achievements.name: Center of Attention
achievements.description: Own both a Protestant and a Reformed Center of Reformation.
achievements.requirements:
- *Not* playing as a released vassal
- Own a Protestant center of reformation
- Own a Reformed center of reformation
achievements.notes:
A random event creates the first Center of Reformation for each 
denomination. After that, the next two nations in Europe to convert have a 
random province designated as a Center of Reformation. Alternatively be on 
the first two to convert to Protestantism, and when you have a new monarch 
and Reformed has spawned, convert to Reformed.

achievements.name: Grand Coalition
achievements.description: Join a coalition of more than 5 nations.
achievements.requirements: Be a part of a coalition with 6 or more members
achievements.notes:
Most easily achieved as Ming by cancelling the tributary status of 
whichever Southeast Asian state has been expanding the most. You still get 
the achievement for joining after the war has started, since you'll need to 
wait for the truce to expire.

achievements.name: Global Hegemony
achievements.description: Reach 100% Strength as any type of Hegemon.
achievements.requirements: Hegemony power is at least 100%

achievements.name: A Kaiser not just in name
achievements.description: Form the Holy Roman Empire.
achievements.requirements: Is Holy Roman Empire
achievements.notes:
Easiest as Austria, playing a normal emperor game, revoking the privilegia 
and then either forming the holy roman empire and continuing to play; or 
saving before forming, and then doing Alt+F4 once the achievement has been 
fulfilled, thereby continuing the campaign with revoke.
