achievements.name: The Chrysanthemum Throne
achievements.description: Unite Japan as a Daimyo.
achievements.requirements:
- Is Japan
- All provinces in Japan region must be either owned and cored by Japan 
or unowned.
achievements.notes:
You must start as a Daimyo subject of the Ashikaga Shogunate. The Japan 
region includes Okinawa, Hokkaido, and the Kuril Islands.

achievements.name: A Decent Reserve
achievements.description: Have a maximum manpower of at least 1 million.
achievements.requirements: Have at least 1 million manpower
achievements.notes:
Although the achievement specifically says "maximum manpower" you actually 
need to have a million saved up and the maximum doesn't matter. Some good 
options of starting nations include Ottomans, which starts with a large 
manpower pool; Muscovy, which can form Russia with its massive manpower 
modifiers; Ming, who can demand manpower from its many tributaries, or Mossi, 
who's unique government reform allows them to extract massive amount of 
manpower from provinces of their primary culture.

achievements.name: A Protected Market
achievements.description: Have 100% Mercantilism.
achievements.requirements: Have *100%* mercantilism
achievements.notes:
Easy to do as Aragon within 1-2 years. Move Aragon's capital (or main trade 
city, if you have Wealth of Nations) out of the Valencia trade node. Send a 
merchant to collect trade in Valencia. Then grant the Burghers the 
'Exclusive Trade Rights' privilege, that grants 3 immediate mercantilism. 
Without unpausing, recall your merchant from Valencia. Unpause, and the 
privilege will be revoked due to there not being a trade node where you own 
3 centers of trade and are collecting. The player can then send the 
merchant to Valencia again, give the privilege and recall the merchant. 
Repeat this process until 100% mercantilism is reached. Alternatively, this 
process can be done with any nation that has 3 centers of trade in any 
trade node and at least one province in a node that the nation does not own 
3 centers of trade. 

Some nations this method can be applied to at the 1444 start date include 
Castile, England, Tunis, Poland, Ming and Vijayanagar.

achievements.name: Three Trivial Tributary Tribes
achievements.description: Have 3 Tribal States as Tributaries.
achievements.startingConditions: Religious group is *Eastern* or government type is *Steppe Nomads*.
achievements.requirements: Has 3 Tributary States with government type tribal*or*native
achievements.notes:
Easily done as Ming at the start of the campaign. Simply loading up an 
ironman campaign of Ming will immediately grant the achievement, as they 
meet the requirements on 11 November 1444. The possible first government 
reforms include, but are not limited to: *Steppe Nomads*, *Tribal Despotism*, 
*Tribal Monarchy*, *Tribal Federation*, *Tribal Democracy*, and *Siberian 
Clan Council*. The government type mapmode can be used to identify 
countries of the correct government type.

achievements.name: Je maintiendrai
achievements.description: Form the Netherlands as a minor nation starting with Dutch culture.
achievements.requirements: Is the Netherlands
achievements.notes:
Possible starts are Holland, Utrecht, Gelre. Easily done as Holland by 
seeking independence support from Burgundy's enemies and then carefully 
eating the other Dutch minors. 

One could also try grabbing the Burgundian inheritance as Gelre, which 
grants most of the land required for free. Remember that you must send the 
royal marriage offer, not them.

achievements.name: Fine Financials
achievements.description: Own Eight level 3 Centres of Trade.
achievements.startingConditions:
- No more than 1 custom nation exists in the world
- Used no more than 201 nation designer points
achievements.requirements: Own 8 provinces that have a level 3 center of trade.
achievements.notes:
The maximum number of level 3 centers of trade equals the number of 
merchants you have. It should be easy to get more merchants with trade 
companies.

-

achievements.name: Trustworthy
achievements.description: Have five allies with 100 trust towards you each.
achievements.requirements: Have 5 allies with 100 trust
achievements.notes:
Can be done as Ming by releasing 5 OPMs (not bordering each other), allying 
them and waiting for the trust to tick up. 

Trust can be gained by honoring calls to arms or by using the *Influence 
nation* interaction as a great power, or with The Cossacks or Leviathan by 
trading favors for trust. If neither The Cossacks nor Leviathan are active, 
trust with allies grows slowly over time.

achievements.name: Full House
achievements.description: Have 3 Vassals and 2 Marches at the same time.
achievements.requirements:
- Have 3 vassals
- Have 2 marches
achievements.notes:
Can be done immediately as Muscovy or Timurids. They start with 5 vassals 
in 1444; simply designate two as marches.

achievements.name: Four For Trade
achievements.description: Form four Trade Companies and get bonus merchants from all of them.
achievements.requirements: Control 4 strong trade companies
achievements.notes:
A trade company must control at least 51% of the *provincial* trade power 
in its node for it to be a "strong" company and give you an extra merchant. 
Far easier since 1.30, as trade companies can now be made in all regions 
not your own that aren't colonial regions, including European regions.

achievements.name: Dude, Where's my Boat?
achievements.description: Capture 20 boats with the Boarding Naval Doctrine.
achievements.startingConditions:
- No more than 1 custom nation exists in the world
- Used no more than 201 nation designer points if playing as a custom 
nation
achievements.requirements:
- Capture 20 boats
- Have the Boarding naval doctrine

achievements.name: An early Reich
achievements.description: Form Germany.
achievements.requirements: Is Germany

achievements.name: Not so sad a state...
achievements.description: As Portugal, have a colony in Brazil and in Africa.
achievements.startingConditions:
- Playing as Portugal
- *Not* using a random New World
achievements.requirements: Have an unfinished colony in both Brazil and in the continent of Africa
achievements.notes:
Establish two colonies in Brazil and in Africa. Keep in mind the colonies 
need to be established, not finished, so this can be done extremely quickly 
after unlocking the first two exploration ideas.

achievements.name: A Fine Goosestep
achievements.description: Form Prussia and have at least 125% Discipline.
achievements.requirements:
- *Not* playing as a released vassal
- Is Prussia
- Have 125% discipline
achievements.notes:
The following actions can increase Prussian discipline: 

- Increasing Militarization of Country (maximum *+10%*)
- Increasing Absolutism (maximum *+5%*)
- Completing Quality Ideas (*+5%*)
- Unlocking “Esprit de Corps” in Offensive ideas (*+5%*)
- Economic-Quality policy “Weapon Quality Standards” (*+5%*)
- Unlocking the Prussian ambition (*+5%*)
- Having a Commandant advisor (*+5%*)
- Having a ruler with the “Strict” personality (*+5%*)
- Converting to Protestantism and obtaining the Aspect of Faith “Holy 
Sacraments” (*+2.5%*)

achievements.name: No Pirates in my Caribbean
achievements.description: Own or have a subject own the entire Caribbean.
achievements.requirements:
- Owns or has a non-tributary subject own all provinces of the Caribbean 
region.
- *Not* a pirate republic
achievements.notes:
- The required provinces are the geographical region of the Caribbean, 
not the colonial region. Don't forget Bermuda.
- Portugal is a good nation to try for this achievement. Simply make 
sure to block Spain from colonizing any provinces in Africa or in any of 
the islands in the Atlantic Ocean. This strategy should give enough time to 
colonize all of the Caribbean. With Mandate of Heaven, the "Portuguese 
Colonial Growth" splendor ability can give Portugal a huge head start. 
Annexing Portugal with Castile in the early game is also a working 
method for being the first in the Caribbean. It is enough to start 
colonizing the province, for it to count towards the achievement.

achievements.name: Electable!
achievements.description: Become an elector in the HRE as a country which does not start as elector.
achievements.startingConditions: Does not start as an elector of the Holy Roman Empire
achievements.requirements:
- *Not* playing as a released vassal
- Become an elector of the Holy Roman Empire
achievements.notes:
Most easily done as Austria via the Usurp the Electorate decision after 
taking Bohemia as a junior partner. Other HRE members can request the 
electorate either with money or by being allied to and having excellent 
relations with the Emperor. Another possibility is to inherit (not 
integrate!) an elector (e.g. as Austria or Hungary, who can both get a 
personal union over Bohemia) at which point the electorate will pass to the 
inheriting partner.

achievements.name: Grand Duchy
achievements.description:
Starting as a Duchy, have 1000 development without upgrading your 
government rank.
achievements.requirements:
- Government rank is Duchy
- Has at least 1000 development
achievements.notes:
Muscovy is the largest duchy in 1444, though Lithuania could also work 
well. The most important thing is to remember *not* to upgrade or form a 
nation (like Russia or Commonwealth) that gives a higher government rank as 
you'll become ineligible for the achievement. 

Another way to do this is to start as a duchy in the HRE. You can become 
the Emperor and still be eligible for the achievement. You just need to 
lose the emperorship, which returns you to duchy rank. This method allows 
you to expand with the governing capacity of an empire, which makes this 
achievement trivial.

achievements.name: A Pile of Gold
achievements.description: Own 10 provinces which produce gold.
achievements.requirements: Own 10 Gold provinces
achievements.notes:
In 1444, the Niger region has 3, the South Africa and East Africa regions 
have 5, the Peru and Upper Peru regions have 6, and the Mexico region has 
10, so it is easiest as a nation like Aztec. Does not require provinces to 
be cored. Provinces owned by colonial nations do *not* count (but playing 
as a released colonial nation does). 
All pre-determined gold provinces

achievements.name: The pen is mightier than the sword
achievements.description: Have three unions at the same time as Austria or Austria-Hungary.
achievements.requirements:
- Is Austria*or*Austria-Hungary
- Have 3 personal unions
achievements.notes:
Austrian missions can give Restore Union CBs on Bohemia and Hungary aswell 
as Poland, Milan, Naples and Bavaria. Check the page for the exact 
requirements. Events can also lead to a Habsburg ruling in Spain, allowing 
Austria the opportunity to claim the throne of Castile, and possibly Aragon 
and Naples as well.

achievements.name: Magellan’s Voyage
achievements.description: Make the first circumnavigation.
achievements.requirements:
- *Not* playing as a released vassal
- Is the first to circumnavigate the World.
achievements.notes:
Colonize along the route as much as possible, or get fleet basing rights. 
Fully-repaired ships can be stationed along the way to join the explorer's 
fleet before he moves to the next sea tile. If the fleet stops to repair, 
ships can also be sent to augment it while it is in port. How long the AI 
takes to circumnavigate varies from game to game.

achievements.name: One Night in Paris
achievements.description:
Start as England, own and have a core on Paris (do not form another 
country unless it's Great Britain or the Angevin Kingdom).
achievements.requirements:
- Is England, Great Britain, *or* the Angevin Kingdom
- Own and core Paris

achievements.name: Multiculturalism
achievements.description:
Have 4 different Cultures and 4 different religions represented in your 
court.
achievements.startingConditions:
- No more than 1 custom nation exists in the world
- Used no more than 201 nation designer points if playing as a custom 
nation
achievements.requirements:
- Four different religions in court
- Four different cultures in court
achievements.notes:
Spawned advisors take the culture and religion of a random held province. 
Easy as Ming: dismiss advisors until you have one Theravada, one Animist, 
and one Vajrayana advisor. Release nations to increase the proportion of 
your provinces which have one of the remaining religions.

achievements.name: All Your Trade Are Belong to Us
achievements.description:
Have the highest trade power in Genoa, Venice and English Channel while 
having an income of at least 300 ducats per month.
achievements.requirements:
- Highest Trade power in Genoa, Venice, and English Channel
- Have 300 income
achievements.notes:
Easily done as England or Netherlands by controlling the English Channel 
via provincial trade power and sending light ships to the Venice and Genoa 
trade nodes.

achievements.name: World Discoverer
achievements.description: Discover all non-wasteland land provinces.
achievements.requirements: Discover all terra incognita.
achievements.notes:
You do not have to discover all Terra Incognita yourself, as TI can be 
automatically uncovered via spread of discovery. The condition is simply 
that no TI exists in the world for you, not including sea zones. Wastelands 
are not needed. Easiest in Europe. With Mare Nostrum DLC, a good way to 
find the last few is to check the Request to share maps diplomatic action 
on colonizers or anybody else.

achievements.name: Tear Down This Wall
achievements.description: Use Artillery Barrage on Berlin.
achievements.requirements: Has used artillery barrage on Berlin.
achievements.notes:
As Brandenburg, wait until you have military technology 7. Recruit at least 
3 units of artillery, mothball the fort of Berlin then tank your legitimacy 
by dishineriting heirs and abdicating. Pretender rebels will siege it down, 
you can then attack and barrage it.

- 
-

achievements.name: AAA Credit
achievements.description: As a Great Power, take on over 1,000 ducats of another nation’s debt.
achievements.requirements:
- Is a Great power
- Has taken on 1000 ducats of another country's debt.
achievements.notes:
Must be done in a single action

-

achievements.name: Live Long and Prosper
achievements.description:
Have 30 states with prosperity at the same time as you have a 70 year old 
ruler.
achievements.requirements:
- 30 states have prosperity
- Current ruler is at least 70 years old

achievements.name: In the Name of the Father
achievements.description: As an Orthodox country, have 100 Patriarch Authority.
achievements.requirements: Have Patriarch Authority of *100%*
achievements.notes:
Constantinople and Kiev have monuments which give yearly patriarch 
authority

achievements.name: Bleed Them Dry
achievements.description: Have 10 different War Reparations being paid to you at the same time.
achievements.requirements: Have 10 War Reparations at the same time
achievements.notes: Can be done more easily as Austria or current Holy Roman Emperor.

achievements.name: One Family to Rule them All
achievements.description:
Have your dynasty on 8 thrones at the same time. Client states do not 
count.
achievements.requirements:
- Is monarchy
- Is *not* in a regency
- Have the same dynasty as 8 other non-client state nations
achievements.notes:
Can be easily done as Ming. Release 8 nations as vassals (make sure you 
pick nations that will have an eastern religion) and use the *Place 
Relative on Throne*Subject interaction.

achievements.name: Absolutely
achievements.description: Gain 100 Absolutism.
achievements.requirements: Have 100 absolutism
achievements.notes:
- Sweden and Prussia have events to increase their maximum absolutism. 
France, Portugal, Sweden, and Russia have events, decisions, or ideas 
that give yearly absolutism gain.

Every monarchy can achieve this with the base of 60 + 15 from 100% 
crownland + 25 from the three relevant government reforms.

achievements.name: Trophy Hunter
achievements.description: Capture an enemy flagship.
achievements.startingConditions:
- No more than 1 custom nation exists in the world
- Used no more than 201 nation designer points if playing as a custom 
nation
achievements.requirements: Capture a flagship

achievements.name: Populists in Government
achievements.description: Switch government type through government reforms.
achievements.startingConditions:
- No more than 1 custom nation exists in the world
- Used no more than 201 nation designer points
achievements.requirements: Has switched government type via a government reform
achievements.notes:
Fastest as a tribal nation, as only 5 reforms are needed to change 
government type.

achievements.name: Voting Streak
achievements.description: Successfully pass 11 issues in a row in Parliament.
achievements.requirements: Pass 11 parliament issues in a row
achievements.notes: England, Navarra, Poland, and Scotland start with a parliament in 1444.

achievements.name: Vasa or Wettin?
achievements.description:
Get a ruler of your dynasty on the throne of Poland or the Commonwealth 
while they are an elective monarchy.
achievements.requirements:
- *Not* playing as a released vassal
- Poland or the Commonwealth has a ruler that is of your dynasty and was 
acquired via the elective monarchy.
achievements.notes:
Once Poland enables elective monarchy countries of the same religion can 
support candidates to their throne via diplomatic action. High diplomatic 
reputation and good relations with Poland increase the likelihood gaining 
support. 

If Poland chooses a local noble instead of the PU with Lithuania it won't 
get an elective monarchy, making this achievement impossible.

achievements.name: Italian Ambition
achievements.description: Form Italy.
achievements.requirements: Is Italy
achievements.notes:
Become Italy. The primary culture of the country you start with should be 
in the Latin culture group (the achievement won't be visible in game unless 
you are Latin) but you can also get the achievement via culture shift. The Papal 
State and The Holy Roman Empire can't form Italy.

achievements.name: Early-Modern Warfare
achievements.description: Have 100 regiments at 100% Army Drill.
achievements.requirements: Have 100 regiments at *100%* Army Drill
achievements.notes:
Easy as Ming; just go slightly over force limit and drill for ten years.

- 
-

achievements.name: Ruina Imperii
achievements.description: Dismantle the Holy Roman Empire.
achievements.requirements:
- There are no countries in the Holy Roman Empire
- Holy Roman Empire does *not* exist
achievements.notes:
Dismantling the Holy Roman Empire requires allying electors or controlling 
their capital as well as controlling the emperor's capital. Note that the 
HRE disbanding itself due to lack of an eligible emperor and another nation 
disbanding HRE both counts for the achievement.

achievements.name: The Continuation of Diplomacy
achievements.description: Successfully use Threaten War to gain a province from another nation.
achievements.requirements: Have acquired a province through threatening war.
achievements.notes: Easily done as Ming after fabricating a claim on either Kham or Korchin.

achievements.name: All belongs to Mother Russia
achievements.description: Start as a country of Russian culture and form Russia.
achievements.requirements: Is Russia
achievements.notes: Easiest to do as Muscovy.

achievements.name: Just a Little Patience
achievements.description: Play a campaign from 1444 until 1820.
achievements.requirements: Is year 1820

achievements.name: At every continent
achievements.description: Own one province on each continent.
achievements.requirements: Own a province in each of the 6 continents.
achievements.notes:
The continents are: Europe, Asia, Africa, North America, South America and 
Oceania. Most easily done as Spain or Portugal, as they can colonize 
faster.

achievements.name: Factionalism
achievements.description: Have 3 different estates in your country with at least 70% influence each.
achievements.requirements: Have 3 estates with 70% influence

achievements.name: Time Bandit
achievements.description: Successfully steal a map from another nation.
achievements.requirements: Stole a map from another country.

achievements.name: Market Control
achievements.description: Be trade leader of seven different goods.
achievements.requirements: Be trade leader in 7 different trade goods
achievements.notes: You will need seven different "Trading in X" modifiers at the same time.

achievements.name: The Emperors new clothes
achievements.description: Overthrow Austria and become the Emperor of the Holy Roman Empire.
achievements.requirements: Is emperor of the Holy Roman Empire
achievements.notes:
Become emperor of the Holy Roman Empire. Austrian players already start as 
the emperor so they won't get the achievement. Easiest to do as Bohemia.

achievements.name: Isn't this the way to India?
achievements.description: Discover the Americas as Castile or Spain.
achievements.startingConditions:
- Playing as Castile
- *Not* using a random New World.
- Has not discovered both North America and South America
achievements.requirements: Has discovered North America and South America
achievements.notes:
Remove the terra incognita of 1 province in the continent of South America 
and 1 province in the continent of North America.

achievements.name: This is My Faith
achievements.description: Convert to Protestantism and unlock 3 Aspects of Faith.
achievements.requirements:
- Is Protestant
- Have 3 aspects of faith
achievements.notes:
Bohemia, the nations in the British Isles and those in Scandinavia start in 
a great position for this achievement.

achievements.name: Bright Spark
achievements.description: Have 50 Innovativeness.
achievements.startingConditions:
- No more than 1 custom nation exists in the world
- Used no more than 201 nation designer points if playing as a custom 
nation
achievements.requirements: - Have 50 Innovativeness
achievements.notes:
Starting as Florence, only focus on technology and ideas, accept all events 
that give innovativeness and always choose the same leader during election, 
can be done before 1550.

- 
-

achievements.name: The Five Colonies
achievements.description: Have five colonial nations.
achievements.requirements: have 5 colonial nations

achievements.name: A Golden Empire
achievements.description: Enact a Golden Age as an Empire.
achievements.requirements:
- Is in a golden era
- Is an empire
achievements.notes:
The golden era can be started on the first day of the next month after 
completing 3 objectives. Easily done as Ming. You begin as an empire, 
already have a 30-development capital, and have more than five centres of 
trade at the beginning, you just need to release five vassals and you can 
begin your golden era.

- 
-

achievements.name: City of Cities
achievements.description: Own a core province with at least 60 development.
achievements.requirements: Own and have core a city with at least 60 development
achievements.notes: Easiest to do as the Ottomans with Constantinople.

achievements.name: Down Under
achievements.description: Have a colony in Australia.
achievements.requirements: Have a colony in Australia.
achievements.notes:
Easily done as one of the nations located in proximity to the region. 
Establish a colony on any province of the Australian coastline (no need to 
finish the colony). Taking someone's colony in Australia when signing peace 
or conquering natives won't earn the achievement.

achievements.name: This navy can take it all
achievements.description: Gain at least 7.0 naval morale.
achievements.requirements: Have *7* Morale of navies
achievements.notes:
Research diplomatic techs, invest in ideas that improve naval morale, 
maintain high prestige and navy tradition. Finally hire a Naval Reformer.

achievements.name: Azur semé de lis or
achievements.description: Get all the French Cores as France.
achievements.requirements: All cored provinces are owned by France
achievements.notes:
Aside from reconquest, can also be done by revoking the cores from 
non-owned provinces

achievements.name: Aggressive Expander
achievements.description: Own 200 provinces.
achievements.requirements: Own 200 provinces.
achievements.notes: Easiest to do as Ming.

achievements.name: All That's Thine Shall Be Mine
achievements.description: As a Greedy ruler, take all of a nation’s ducats in a peace deal.
achievements.requirements:
*Took all of an enemy nation's ducats in a peace deal, during the reign of 
a Greedy Ruler.*
achievements.notes:
Can be achieved without being the warleader by having a Greedy ruler and 
the warleader taking all of a nation's ducats in a peace deal. The rulers 
of Amago, Cleves, Cologne, Hatakeyama, Isshiki, Khandesh, Lüneburg and Otomo 
are greedy at the start of the game.

achievements.name: My armies are invincible!
achievements.description: Gain at least 7.0 land morale.
achievements.requirements: Have *7* Morale of armies
achievements.notes:
Research military techs, invest in ideas that improve morale, maintain high 
prestige and army tradition. Finally hire an Army Reformer. Easiest as 
Prussia or Sunda, with their national ideas that give +20% morale.

achievements.name: Total Control
achievements.description: Own 100 or more provinces with no local autonomy or unrest.
achievements.requirements: Own 100 provinces that have *0%* unrest and autonomy

achievements.name: Royal Authority
achievements.description: Install a union through a succession war.
achievements.requirements: Have installed a union in a succession war.
achievements.notes:
- Win a war with the "Claim on Throne" or "Restore Union" casus belli. 
The former is used in succession wars. Only requires winning a war with the 
right CB; the peace deal does not actually need to force a union.
- Easily done as Muscovy against Ryazan, or against Tver with a claim on 
throne.

achievements.name: Double the Love
achievements.description: Start with no unions and get two at the same time.
achievements.requirements: Have 2 or more personal unions
achievements.notes:
This does not mean inheriting two personal unions simultaneously, only that 
a country starting with no personal unions eventually holds two at the same 
time. Brandenburg gains a union over AI Ansbach by event when their 
starting heir succeeds to the throne, inheriting Ansbach's own union over 
Bayreuth. Muscovy can claim the thrones of Tver and Ryazan. Castile can get 
a union over Aragon and Naples if the Iberian Wedding occurs while Aragon 
maintained their union with Naples or got a union over Navarra from the 
event *“The Death of King Alfonso”*. Castile can also get a Restoration of 
Union CB against Portugal from their missions. Poland and Austria can get 
Restoration of Union CBs through events or missions (and Poland can 
reliably get a union with Lithuania by event).

achievements.name: Queen of Conquest
achievements.description: Conquer land while in a Queen Regency.
achievements.requirements:
- Have a consort regency with a female consort
- Conquered land

achievements.name: Gentle Persuasion
achievements.description: Have a Siege Specialist general win a siege in a province with a fort.
achievements.startingConditions: No restriction of the start date
achievements.requirements:
Won a siege against a fort using a General with the Siege Specialist 
trait.
achievements.notes: Easily done as France as they begin with a siege specialist general.

achievements.name: Blockader
achievements.description: Blockade at least 10 ports of one enemy.
achievements.requirements: Blockade at least 10 enemy ports at the same time.
achievements.notes: Easily done as the Ottomans with the Mamluks at the start of the campaign.

achievements.name: Truly Divine Ruler
achievements.description: Get a 5/5/5 Ruler or higher.
achievements.startingConditions: Starting ruler has less than *5* skill in any category
achievements.requirements: Have a ruler that has at least *5* skill in every category
achievements.notes:
Easiest way to obtain this achievement is starting with Poland and appoint 
a local noble ruler for the event. 

Alternatively, start as a republic and re-elect 4 times.

achievements.name: Combined Arms
achievements.description: Have both an Admiral and a General with a trait.
achievements.startingConditions: No restriction of the start date
achievements.requirements:
- Have an Admiral with a trait
- Have a General with a trait
achievements.notes:
- Conquistadors and explorers do not count.
- Leaders gain traits at the end of battles with a chance based on the military 
tradition gain from that battle, which is based (in part) on the number 
of losses inflicted on the enemy. The Ottomans and France start with a 
general with a trait in 1444.

achievements.name: It's all about luck
achievements.description: Win a battle against a great leader, without a leader.
achievements.requirements: Defeated an enemy leader with 3 stars.
achievements.notes: Easily done as the Ottomans attacking Albania at the start of the campaign.

achievements.name: Respected
achievements.description: Have 100 prestige, 100 legitimacy and three stability.
achievements.requirements:
- Have *100* prestige
- Have *100* legitimacy
- Have *+3* stability
achievements.notes:
- Fight battles and explore terra incognita to increase prestige.
- Maintain positive stability, have heirs with strong claim and control 
the amount of royal marriages to increase legitimacy.
- Wait for stability improving events and invest administrative points 
to increase stability.
- Easy to achieve as Russia. The decision *“Make St. Petersburg the 
Capital”* gives the player *100* prestige, which fulfills the most 
difficult requirement if the player had non-negative prestige.
- Having a level 3 advisor or higher will eventually cause an event to 
trigger that will let the player choose to gain *50* prestige.

achievements.name: The Princess is in this Castle
achievements.description:
As a country that does not start with a female heir, have a female heir 
while having a Castle in your capital (more advanced fort buildings do not 
count).
achievements.startingConditions: Does not have a female heir
achievements.requirements:
- *Not* playing as a released vassal
- Capital has Castle
- Have a female heir
achievements.notes:
Easily done as Castile by waiting for the Iberian wedding event while not 
upgrading or deleting the capital fort. Note that most Muslim countries 
cannot get female heirs, and those that can have a very low probability of 
getting one.

achievements.name: Defender of the Faith
achievements.description: Become Defender of the Faith.
achievements.requirements: Is defender of the faith
achievements.notes:
Can be done immediately as Ottomans, just take out a few loans and claim 
the title.

achievements.name: It's all about the money
achievements.description: Accumulate 3000 gold.
achievements.requirements: Have *3,000* ducats in the treasury
achievements.notes: Easily done as a big nation by taking loans until reaching the target.

achievements.name: True Catholic
achievements.description: Control three Cardinals.
achievements.requirements: Have 3 or more controlled cardinals
achievements.notes:
The achievement only triggers if the number of player controlled cardinals 
is greater than or equal to (≥) 3. If the player starts with 2 or more 
cardinals the achievement will not be awarded. Easily done as Spain. Can be 
done immediately by starting as the Papal States and bribing 3 cardinals 
into your lands.

achievements.name: Cold War
achievements.description: Win a war without fighting a single battle.
achievements.requirements: Won one war without fighting a single battle.
achievements.notes:
Start as a neighbor of an OPM. Go to a total war with them and sign peace 
(break their alliances if needed and take all their money). Soon after 
declare another war (breaking the truce) and capture their undefended 
capital. Naval battles do not prevent the achievement.

achievements.name: For the Glory
achievements.description: Diplo-annex a vassal.
achievements.requirements: Have diplomatically annexed a vassal.
achievements.notes:
Start as Ayutthaya, then annex either of their vassals after 10 years. Also 
easy with Denmark which can annex its vassal Holstein.

achievements.name: That's a Grand Navy
achievements.description: Build up your navy to your country's maximum navy forcelimit.
achievements.startingConditions: Navy size isn't *99%* of maximum force limit
achievements.requirements: Have a navy size that is *99%* of maximum force limit

achievements.name: Seriously?!
achievements.description: Kill 10,000 men in one battle.
achievements.requirements: Have killed 10 000 men in one battle.

achievements.name: Brothers in Arms
achievements.description: Win a war as a secondary participant.
achievements.requirements: Won a war without being the war leader.

achievements.name: That is mine!
achievements.description: Conquer a province.
achievements.requirements: Have conquered one new province.

achievements.name: That's a Grand Army
achievements.description: Build up your army to your country's maximum army forcelimit.
achievements.startingConditions: Army size isn't *99%* of maximum force limit
achievements.requirements: Have an army size that is *99%* of maximum force limit
achievements.notes:
This achievement is not awarded if the player plays a nation that already 
is at or is over its maximum force limit.

achievements.name: Victorious!
achievements.description: Win a war.
achievements.requirements: Has won a war.
achievements.notes: Win a war as the main participant.

achievements.name: Until death do us apart
achievements.description: Secure a Royal Marriage with another country.
achievements.requirements: Have a royal marriage
achievements.notes:
Note that it won't trigger if the player already has one or more royal 
marriages at game start.
